findings.claim: The target achievements are Steel Soul (API key STEEL_SOUL, 'Finish the game in Steel Soul mode') and Speedrunner (SPEEDRUN_1, 'Complete the game in under 5 hours'). The related 100% variants are Speed Completion (SPEED_COMPLETION, '100% and finish in under 30 hours') and Steel Heart (STEEL_SOUL_FULL, '100% and finish in Steel Soul mode'). Completion is COMPLETION (100%).
findings.detail: Steam global unlock rates from the Steam API on 2026-09-28: SPEEDRUN_1 4.9%, SPEED_COMPLETION 4.0%, STEEL_SOUL 3.8%, STEEL_SOUL_FULL 3.0%, COMPLETION 16.9%, ENDING_A (Weaver Queen) 41.0%, ENDING_C (Snared Silk) 39.5%, ENDING_E (Sister of the Void) 29.7%, ENDING_D (Twisted Child) 17.3%. The game has 52 achievements. Chinese names from secondary sources: 钢铁之魂 = Steel Soul, 钢铁之心 = Steel Heart, 极速圆满 = Speed Completion; the Speedrunner name is given variously (e.g. 疾丝跑者).

findings.claim: All four completion-type achievements are awarded in one function, GameManager.CheckCompletionAchievements(). It uses exact thresholds on playerData.playTime in seconds. Speedrunner does not depend on the mode, so one Steel Soul run can earn both STEEL_SOUL and SPEEDRUN_1 at once.
findings.detail: Decompiled code (release build 1.0.28324): CountGameCompletion(); flag = playerData.permadeathMode > PermadeathModes.Off; flag2 = playerData.completionPercentage >= 100f; if(flag) AwardAchievement("STEEL_SOUL") + MenuStyleUnlock("COMPLETED_STEEL"); if(flag2){AwardAchievement("COMPLETION"); if(flag) AwardAchievement("STEEL_SOUL_FULL");} if(playerData.playTime <= 18000f) AwardAchievement("SPEEDRUN_1"); if(flag2 && playerData.playTime <= 108000f) AwardAchievement("SPEED_COMPLETION"). The 5 h limit is inclusive (<= 18000 s) and there is no completion-% requirement for Speedrunner. People have done both in one run: a sina.cn write-up reports Speedrunner + Steel Soul on one save with 3h59m in-game ('打了一结局'), and a Bilibili run BV1TFpAz8EV7 did the same. Both used save backups (SL).

findings.claim: Any ending that rolls credits counts as 'finishing the game'. The fastest valid target is Ending 1, Weaver Queen (ENDING_A): beat Grand Mother Silk at the end of Act 2 without having done the Silk and Soul wish. Act 3 and the true ending are not required.
findings.detail: Endings: Weaver Queen (Act 2, beat Grand Mother Silk and bind her; afterwards the save respawns at the last save point), Snared Silk (ENDING_C: Silk and Soul wish + Needolin at Grand Mother Silk, continues into Act 3), Twisted Child (ENDING_D: cursed through the Rite of Rebirth / Witch Crest, not Infestation Operation), Sister of the Void (ENDING_E: Lost Lace in Act 3), Passing of the Age (Herald's wish after ending E). The wiki says RecPermadeathMode is unlocked 'by reaching the credits (ending A, C, D or E)'. PlayMaker action SetEndingCompleted sets PlayerData.CompletedEndings flags (Act2Regular=1, Act2Cursed=2, Act2SoulSnare=4, Act3Ending=8) and LastCompletedEnding. The call to CheckCompletionAchievements lives in a PlayMaker FSM, not in C#, so exactly which endings trigger it is inferred. Speedrunner guides and players who earned it all end at Grand Mother Silk (Act 2). The speedrun.com Any% rule is 'Beat the game with any ending'.

findings.claim: The Speedrunner timer is the save file's in-game playTime, not real time. It only advances while GameState is PLAYING, ENTERING_LEVEL or EXITING_LEVEL, the inventory is closed, and the frame took less than 1 second.
findings.detail: GameManager.Update() calls IncreaseGameTimer(ref sessionPlayTimer), with the condition (GameState==PLAYING || ENTERING_LEVEL || EXITING_LEVEL) && !PlayerData.instance.isInventoryOpen && Time.unscaledDeltaTime < 1f, then timer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime. Consequences: (a) the pause menu (GameState.PAUSED), the main menu, CUTSCENE state (CinematicPlayer in-game videos, non-gameplay scenes, intro) and LOADING are not counted; LOADING is only set when loading a save from the menu (GameManager ~line 5120). (b) Normal room-to-room transitions do count, because they run as EXITING_LEVEL/ENTERING_LEVEL. So guides saying 'loading screens don't count' are only partly right. (c) Opening the inventory (GameManager.SetIsInventoryOpen) stops the timer. (d) Unscaled time is used, so hit-stop and slow-motion still count at real speed. (e) In-engine dialogues and boss intros where the state stays PLAYING count. (f) Single frames longer than 1 s are dropped. The live value is GameManager.PlayTime = sessionStartTime + sessionPlayTimer. sessionPlayTimer is added to playerData.playTime only when the game saves (GetSaveGameData / PreparePlayerDataForSave). The save slot shows the time as 'Xh YYm' (SaveStats.GetPlaytimeHHMM).

findings.claim: Steel Soul is unlocked either by reaching the credits once or by entering the cheat code on the main-menu Extras page. No prior completion is needed.
findings.detail: CheatCodeListener sequence: Up, Down, Up, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right. If GetStatusRecordInt("RecPermadeathMode")==0 it calls PermadeathUnlock.Unlock(), which sets RecPermadeathMode=1 in Platform RoamingSharedData (shared status record, not per slot). A new game is started through GameManager.StartNewGame(permadeathMode:true), which sets playerData.permadeathMode = PermadeathModes.On (enum Off=0, On=1, Dead=2).

findings.claim: On a lethal death in Steel Soul the save is not deleted. Instead it is marked Dead, saved immediately, and the slot becomes 'DEFEATED'. There is no cocoon and no respawn, and the in-game restore-save button is hidden for that slot.
findings.detail: HeroController.Die(): unless the death is nonLethal or the scene is a memory scene (gm.IsMemoryScene() forces nonLethal), permadeathMode goes from On to Dead. It also sets playerData.disablePause=true at the very start of the death. GameManager.PlayerDead(): SaveGame(profileID), then if isPermaDead LoadScene("PermaDeath") instead of ReadyForRespawn. SaveSlotButton: when saveStats.PermadeathMode==Dead the slot state is Defeated (broken steel orb and 'DEFEATED' text), restoreSaveButton.Hide(), and choosing the slot only offers ClearSavePrompt, which clears the file. Deaths that do not count (wiki): losing to First Sinner, Shakra, or Garmond and Zaza, and dying inside Elegy of the Deep memories. However, 'being hit into the spikes counts as an actual death', i.e. a hazard hit that takes the last mask. Wiki: 'Exiting and reloading the saved slot when close to death can prevent the slot DEFEATED'. This must happen before Die() starts, because pause is disabled from that point.

findings.claim: The achievement check does not verify that the run was never restored. Restoring a backup, or editing permadeathMode from 2 back to 1, still passes the STEEL_SOUL check (permadeathMode > Off) and also rolls playTime back. This is the 'SL' method human Steel Soul + 5 h runners used.
findings.detail: Save files: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Team Cherry\Hollow Knight Silksong\<steamid>\user1-4.dat. Auto-saves are in Restore_Points#/restoreData#.dat (1-99) and NODELrestoreData#.dat (kept for ACT_1/ACT_2/ACT_3). The format is JSON encrypted with Encryption.Encrypt and wrapped with BinaryFormatter (GameManager.GetBytesForSaveJson); community tool: martinshift.github.io/silksaver. The Steam guide 3586243594 edits "permadeathMode": 2 to 1. The Bilibili uploader of BV1TFpAz8EV7 says they used 'at least a dozen SL/rollbacks' and admits it is not a 'true' Steel Soul clear. AchievementHandler.AwardAchievementToPlayer only checks DemoMode, that the key exists, CanAwardAchievement (a leftover map-zone whitelist for GODS_GLORY), and that it is not already unlocked. There is no mod or cheat detection.

findings.claim: Steel Soul mode changes some content but not core combat or physics. None of the changes are on the core Act 2 critical path, but the map and state model need Steel Soul variants.
findings.detail: From the wiki: Styx is dead in his nest and a new passage leads to Skynx, who buys Silkeaters for 46-154 rosaries. The two Act 3 Void Masses in that nest are gone. The Queen's Egg delivery wish and its Materium entry are unavailable, and Liquid Lacquer has different prerequisites. A Blasted Steps room that held a Silkeater is replaced by Steel Seer Zi and the wish 'A Vassal Lost' (NPC Sula, an exclusive boss Summoned Saviour down a new Bone Bottom passage, reward Growstone). Dead Bug's Purse is replaced by Shell Satchel. The White Bellhome lacquer becomes Chrome. In code, MateriumItem and EnemyJournalRecord have RequiredTypes.RequiredSteelSoul entries, so the 100%/journal requirements differ slightly in Steel Soul. Cosmetic: steel mask HUD (SteelSoulAnimProxy) and the COMPLETED_STEEL menu style.

findings.claim: There are no no-heal, no-bench, no-hit or pacifist style achievements. The only achievements that combine naturally with a Steel Soul speed run are the ending achievements (Weaver Queen / ENDING_A) and the progression achievements along the route. Completion, Steel Heart and Speed Completion need 100%, which is a much larger scope.
findings.detail: The challenge section on the wiki lists exactly Keen Hunter, True Hunter, Completion, Speed Completion, Speedrunner, Steel Soul and Steel Heart. A 100% Steel Soul run under 30 h (<=108000 s) would award STEEL_SOUL, STEEL_SOUL_FULL, COMPLETION and SPEED_COMPLETION together, but not SPEEDRUN_1 unless it finished in 5 h or less. For scale, the fastest 100% runs on speedrun.com are 13799 s (All Glitches) and 16253 s LRT (NMG).

findings.claim: No patch up to the latest PC version, 1.0.30000, changed the achievement thresholds, the timer logic or the Steel Soul death rule. The only achievement-related patch note was a wording change for the Herald's Wish achievement.
findings.detail: Official Steam patch posts: 1.0.28497 (2025-09-12), 1.0.28650 (2025-09-22), 1.0.28891 (2025-10-14), 1.0.29242 (2025-11-07), 1.0.30000 (posted 2026-03-16). 1.0.28650: Herald's Wish description clarified; 'Fixed Liquid Lacquer courier delivery not being accessible in Steel Soul mode'; 'Fixed various instances of dying to bosses while killing them causing death sequences to play messily'. 1.0.28891: 'Game now pauses when the controller disconnects'. The EylonShachmon annotated diff of Assembly-CSharp through 1.0.30000 records these relevant code changes: Patch 1 'Made Queued Achievements award on death' (PlayerDead); MateriumItem Steel-Soul-specific completion flag; 1.0.29242 HeroController.CheckDeathCatch() plus more death checks; UIManager 'disabled returning to main menu while pausing or save quitting is disabled'; QuitToMenu DidSaveAndQuit flag. None of these touch IncreaseGameTimer or CheckCompletionAchievements. Balance changes that matter for combat models: 1.0.28497 'Slight difficulty reduction in early game bosses Moorwing and Sister Splinter', 'Reduction in damage from Sandcarvers', lower mid-game Bellway/Bell Bench prices, and more rosary rewards. 1.0.30000: Last Judge death explosion 3 to 2 damage, a new bench beside Pale Lake, and Silk Soar through top exits. speedrun.com lists 1.0.30000 as the newest PC patch; the NMG Any% top runs use 1.0.28324.

findings.claim: The free Sea of Sorrow expansion was announced on 2025-12-16 for 'in 2026' and had not been released as of the latest sources found. The last official Steam announcement is patch 1.0.30000, called the 'last significant update' before the DLC.
findings.detail: The Steam news feed shows no post after 2026-03-16. The hollowknight.wiki Sea of Sorrow page lists the version as TBD. If it releases, it may change the world, completion %, and possibly achievements, endings or routes, which is why the game version should be pinned.

findings.claim: Human reference times suggest 5 h of in-game time is a loose limit for an optimized no-glitch route, so the bot's time budget can favour safety.
findings.detail: speedrun.com Any% No Major Glitches best time is 2884 s (about 48 min) LRT on patch 1.0.28324. Casual 5 h achievement players report 3.5-4.9 h in-game (Bahamut post about 3.5 h; Steam thread 4h27m-4h56m, where the High Halls gauntlet cost one player about 1 h). The sina.cn Steel Soul + speedrun run finished at 3h59m in-game with no maps bought, benches and stations only where needed (Bellhart, Far Fields, Bone Bottom, Grand Gate/Citadel), and one mask shard bought.

implications_for_bot: Single-run plan: a Steel Soul slot, ending at Weaver Queen (Grand Mother Silk at the end of Act 2, without starting the Silk and Soul wish). If the final saved playerData.playTime is 18000 s or less, the run earns both STEEL_SOUL and SPEEDRUN_1. Budget with a margin (for example 4.5 h, i.e. 16200 s), because the credits check reads playerData.playTime and it is unclear whether the session time is flushed to it before the check.

The time tracker should model the real timer rule: count PLAYING plus room transitions (ENTERING_LEVEL/EXITING_LEVEL); do not count the pause menu, inventory, CUTSCENE or menu loads. Read GameManager.PlayTime (sessionStartTime + sessionPlayTimer) from memory, or playTime from the decrypted user#.dat, rather than a wall clock. Room transitions do count, so a route with fewer transitions saves time.

The bot may use the pause menu or inventory as free thinking time for heavy planning, since neither advances the timer. Map reading through the inventory is also free. Whether the quick map pauses the timer is unverified.

The safety layer must act before the killing hit. Die() sets disablePause=true immediately, and the permadeath flag is saved during PlayerDead. An emergency 'pause, then Save & Quit' is only possible while pausing is allowed; since 1.0.29242, return-to-menu is also blocked whenever pause or save-quit is disabled. The trigger should fire when predicted incoming damage is at least current HP, including hazards (spikes or acid on the last mask are a real death).
Nonlethal zones (memory scenes such as Elegy of the Deep memories, and the First Sinner, Shakra, Garmond and Zaza spars) can be flagged as lower risk in the risk model.

For development and training, run the same route in Classic mode, or use slot backups (copy user#.dat and the Restore_Points folder), so failed attempts do not require restarting from zero. The achievement code does not detect restored or edited saves, and restoring also rolls playTime back. Whether the final run uses backups is the user's call: it works technically, but it goes against the permadeath intent.

Steel Soul can be unlocked with the Extras-menu code (Up, Down, Up, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right), so no prior full clear is needed. An automation script can enter it before selecting the Steel Soul new game.

Map and state database: include the Steel-Soul-only differences (dead Styx nest and the Skynx passage, the Steel Seer Zi room in Blasted Steps, Shell Satchel instead of Dead Bug's Purse, the Bone Bottom passage). Key world-state flags off the PlayerData fields (e.g. Unlocked*Station, permadeathMode, CompletedEndings) rather than pixels where possible.

Pin the game version: turn off Steam auto-update or use a depot download, and keep enemy and attack models per version. 1.0.28497 changed Moorwing, Sister Splinter and Sandcarver damage; 1.0.30000 changed Last Judge's explosion damage, added a Pale Lake bench and allowed Silk Soar through top exits. The latest PC version is 1.0.30000; the Sea of Sorrow expansion could change the world later.
The achievement code has no mod detection, so a BepInEx plugin that exports game state (HP, silk, position, enemy FSM states) should not block Steam achievements, based on the release-build code.
open_questions: Which PlayMaker FSM or scene calls GameManager.CheckCompletionAchievements, and does it fire for all credit endings? In particular, does Snared Silk (the Act 2 ending that continues into Act 3) award Speedrunner or Steel Soul? Also, is playTime flushed (saved) before the check or after?

Were IncreaseGameTimer or CheckCompletionAchievements changed after 1.0.28324? The annotated change list through 1.0.30000 shows no such change, but it says it is not exhaustive. Confirm by decompiling the current Assembly-CSharp.dll with ILSpy.
Does the quick map (the dedicated map button, not the inventory map tab) set isInventoryOpen or pause, i.e. does it stop the timer?
Does the game pause, or stop counting time, when the window loses focus? This matters if the bot's capture or input runs with the game in the background or with the Steam overlay open.
When loading after a Save & Quit near death, where exactly does Hornet respawn (last bench, i.e. respawnScene/respawnMarker)? Is any state lost? This defines the cost of the emergency-quit fallback.
Sea of Sorrow release date and whether it adds or changes achievements, endings, completion %, or the Steel Soul and timer rules.
Do restore-point auto-saves (Restore_Points#/restoreData#.dat) get created for Steel Soul slots, and are they deleted when a DEFEATED slot is cleared?

findings.claim: Silksong's Windows/Steam build uses the Mono scripting backend, not IL2CPP. Assembly-CSharp.dll is a normal managed .NET assembly that ILSpy/dnSpyEx decompile almost 1:1.
findings.detail: Evidence 1: the community NuGet package Silksong.GameLibs 1.2.0-silksong1.0.30000 ships stripped/publicized managed assemblies. These include Assembly-CSharp.dll (4,044,288 B), Assembly-CSharp-firstpass.dll, PlayMaker.dll, TeamCherry.TK2D.dll, Unity.InputSystem.dll, Unity.Addressables.dll, com.rlabrecque.steamworks.net.dll, GalaxyCSharp.dll, XGamingRuntime.dll, SharpDX.DirectInput.dll and Newtonsoft.Json.dll, all targeting netstandard2.1. An IL2CPP game would have GameAssembly.dll plus global-metadata.dat instead. Evidence 2: BepInEx 5 runs the game, and BepInEx 5 supports Mono only. Evidence 3: the LiveSplit autosplitter reads memory through asr's Mono module (version V3), starting from the static GameManager._instance. Evidence 4: mods such as SilksongRL, DebugMod and DisableAchievements use HarmonyX to patch game methods.

findings.claim: The launch build runs on Unity 6000.0.50f1 (Unity 6). The engine was upgraded in a second build of patch 1.0.28714 (about October 2025), and I could not confirm the exact current Unity version.
findings.detail: BepInEx issue #1158 has a log showing 'Unity v6000.0.50.3512832', and many Steam crash dialogs read 'Unity 6000.0.50f1'. The hk-speedrunning manifests page says 1.0.28714 exists in two Windows builds: manifest 5977483240701257214 has a newer Unity version that makes some glitches harder, and manifest 6773297648406051922 keeps the old one. That timing matches Unity's CVE-2025-59489 fix (patched releases include 6000.0.58f2), but I did not verify which exact 6000.0.x the game moved to. The libTAS docs say Silksong uses a custom Unity build, so stock symbol resolution fails.

findings.claim: The game version live on Steam as of the latest community sources is 1.0.30000 (24 March 2026). Every past version can be downloaded from Steam app 1030300, Windows depot 1030301, using the listed manifest IDs, so a bot can be pinned to one build.
findings.detail: Version history with release dates: 1.0.28324 (launch, 2025-09-04), 1.0.28497 (Patch 1, 2025-09-10), 1.0.28561, 1.0.28650 (Patch 2, 2025-09-18), 1.0.28714, 1.0.28891 (Patch 3, 2025-10-07), 1.0.29242 (Patch 4, 2025-11-07), 1.0.29315, 1.0.29909 (Patch 5, 2026-03-16), 1.0.29926, 1.0.29980 and 1.0.30000 (2026-03-24, adds a bench near Pale Lake). Windows manifest for 1.0.30000: 4421626056705534276. Windows manifest for launch 1.0.28324: 3229726349000518284. The Silksong.GameLibs NuGet versions follow the same game builds; the newest is 1.2.0-silksong1.0.30000, published 2026-03-25. Team Cherry called Patch 5 the 'last significant update' before the free Sea of Sorrow expansion (announced 2025-12-16, due in 2026). I found no evidence that Sea of Sorrow or a 1.1.x build had shipped by 2026-09-28, but I could not confirm it had not.

findings.claim: The standard loader is BepInEx 5.4.23.4 (x64). The community package is silksong_modding/BepInExPack_Silksong 1.0.3; BepInEx 6 is not used by the community.
findings.detail: The pack is BepInEx_win_x64_5.4.23.4 with cross-platform fixes, a preconfigured BepInEx.cfg, run_bepinex.sh for Linux/Mac, and a steam_appid.txt so the game can start without going through Steam. The older package BepInEx/BepInExPack_Silksong (5.4.75304) is deprecated and now redirects to it. Installation: extract into the folder that contains 'Hollow Knight Silksong.exe'; the loader is Unity Doorstop (winhttp proxy), and plugins go in BepInEx/plugins. To launch unmodded, add the launch option '--doorstop-enabled false'. Known problem: issue #1158, 'Unable to start Unity log writer' on 5.4.23.3, is still open. Ecosystem: Thunderstore (community 'hollow-knight-silksong', roughly 400+ packages) is the main host, with Nexus as a secondary one. Mod managers: Gale (recommended by hk-speedrunning), r2modman, Thunderstore Mod Manager, Cogfly, Needlelight (a Lumafly fork) and lacesong. Hooking libraries: HarmonyX (bundled with BepInEx) and MonoDetour (MonoDetour_BepInEx_5 0.7.16, used by ItemChanger.Silksong). Support channel: HK/Silksong Modding Discord (discord.gg/VDsg3HmWuB).

findings.claim: The community's shared API is a set of BepInEx libraries from the 'silksong-modding' GitHub org and Thunderstore team. HK1's Modding API and Satchel were not ported; these libraries replace them.
findings.detail: Thunderstore libraries (silksong_modding): FsmUtil 0.3.17 (PlayMakerFSM editing), ModMenu 0.8.0, I18N 1.1.1, Modlist 0.3.1 (DebugMod silently fails to load without it), AssetHelper 1.3.2, DataManager 1.2.2 (global and per-slot mod data), UnityHelper 1.2.0, and SilksongPrepatcher 1.4.0. The Prepatcher exposes PlayerDataVariableEvents<T>.OnGetVariable and OnSetVariable (for example OnSetBool(PlayerData pd, string fieldName, bool current)), which gives a hook on every PlayerData read and write. It also has a PlayerDataAccess wrapper. Build tooling: 'dotnet new install Silksong.Modding.Templates', then 'dotnet new silksongplugin' (needs the .NET 10 SDK; -gv picks the game version). NuGet Silksong.GameLibs uses versions of the form '<pkg>-silksong<gameversion>'. Docs live at https://docs.silksong-modding.org. When checked, github.com/silksong-modding/* repos returned 404 even though the org exists; mirrors are at github.com/HK-Modding-Preservation. An alternative loader, CradleAPI, exists but is niche.

findings.claim: As in HK1, enemies and bosses are driven by PlayMaker FSMs. A plugin can read a boss's current state (for example Lace's attack) from PlayMakerFSM.ActiveStateName, its animation from tk2dSpriteAnimator.CurrentClip.name, and its HP from HealthManager.hp.
findings.detail: PlayMaker.dll ships with the game (HutongGames.PlayMaker namespace). SilksongRL's LaceEncounter maps FSM state-name prefixes to attack classes: Idle/Hop/Wallcling/Refight = neutral; ComboSlash/Pose; Counter; RapidSlash; 'J Slash'; Downstab; Charge; Evade; CrossSlash/'Slash Slam'; Multihit; Stun. That gives 11 categories, and 'time since this attack started' is used as a feature (Lace's attacks last up to about 1.9 s). Its BossStateLogger logs every FSM state change with durations and every tk2d clip change, which is the tool for building tell/range tables for new bosses. Bosses are identified by the HealthManager GameObject name (for example 'Lace Boss2 New'). DebugMod finds damaging objects with LocateMyFSM('damages_hero') and the templated FSM 'hornet_multi_wounder'. Existing FSM inspectors: FsmMaster (ConstructiveCynicism; live graph, variable editing, custom RNG sequencing, DebugMod savestate integration), Cinematic Unity Explorer (Yukikaco; a UnityExplorer fork with an FSM viewer and collider/enemy inspect) and FsmTool (capitalistspz).

findings.claim: DebugMod's HitboxRender contains a working classifier that sorts every Collider2D in a scene into enemy/hazard, terrain, player, player attack, transition gate, hazard-respawn, breakable, interactable and other. It can be reused directly as a ground-truth 'terrain plus threat' extractor.
findings.detail: The code is in hk-speedrunning/Silksong.DebugMod Hitbox/HitboxRender.cs. Enemy/hazard: collider has a DamageHero component, FSM 'damages_hero', templated FSM 'hornet_multi_wounder', a CogMultiHitter, or a TriggerEnterEvent whose parent has a RangeAttackGroup (sand worm). Terrain: gameObject.layer == PhysLayers.TERRAIN (an active NonSlider marks non-slide terrain). Player: HeroController.instance.gameObject with a non-trigger collider. Player attack: DamageEnemies, FSM 'damages_enemy', or name 'Damager' with FSM 'Damage'. Also classified: HazardRespawnTrigger (trigger), TransitionPoint (trigger, a gate), Breakable or layer 'Interactive Object', Lever/Lever_tk2d, HarpoonHook (Clawline anchor), tag 'Geo', NoClamberRegion (cannot ledge-grab) and AlertRange (enemy aggro range). New colliders are picked up through ModHooks.ColliderCreateHook and SceneManager.activeSceneChanged. The camera is 2D Toolkit (GameCameras.instance.tk2dCam.ZoomFactor). Colours: yellow = Hornet, red = enemy/hazard, cyan = attack, green = terrain, dark blue = gate, purple = hazard respawn. Separate hitbox mods: 'Show Hitbox' (ykysnk; github T2PeNBiX99wcoxKv3A4g/HKSS.ShowHitbox, F11 toggles the game's built-in debug hitbox view) and 'Show Hitbox (Redone)' on Nexus (#836).

findings.claim: Player and world state is available as named Mono fields, both in-process and by reading memory externally. The key roots are GameManager._instance, its playerData field (a PlayerData object) and hero_ctrl.cState (HeroControllerStates).
findings.detail: Field names come from the autosplitter's silksong_memory.rs and its Silksong-Mono-dissector.TXT. The dissector's offsets are for one build only, so resolve by name. PlayerData: health, maxHealth, maxHealthBase, heartPieces, silk, silkMax, silkRegenMax, silkSpoolParts, geo (rosaries), ShellShards, playTime (float, the in-game timer), permadeathMode (GlobalEnums.PermadeathModes), completionPercentage, respawnScene, atBench, isInventoryOpen, disablePause and version. Skills: hasNeedleThrow, hasParry, hasThreadSphere, hasSilkCharge, hasSilkBomb, hasSilkBossNeedle, hasDash, hasWalljump, hasChargeSlash, hasDoubleJump, hasSuperJump, hasHarpoonDash, hasBrolly, hasNeedolin. Bosses: defeatedMossMother, defeatedBellBeast, defeatedLace1, defeatedSongGolem, defeatedVampireGnatBoss, spinnerDefeated, defeatedLastJudge, defeatedPhantom, defeatedCogworkDancers, defeatedSongChevalierBoss, defeatedTrobbio, defeatedLaceTower, and more. Act flag used by Benchwarp: act3_wokeUp. HeroControllerStates: facingRight, onGround, jumping, falling, dashing, touchingWall, wallSliding, transitioning, attacking, dead, hazardDeath, hazardRespawning, recoiling, recoilFrozen, invulnerable, isSprinting, parrying, isBinding, isMaggoted. GameManager: sceneName, nextSceneName, entryGateName, <GameState>k__BackingField (0 INACTIVE, 1 MAIN_MENU, 2 LOADING, 3 ENTERING_LEVEL, 4 PLAYING, 6 EXITING_LEVEL, 7 CUTSCENE), <ui>k__BackingField.uiState (4 PLAYING, 5 PAUSED), <inputHandler>k__BackingField.acceptingInput, and sceneLoad. Special scenes: Menu_Title, Quit_To_Menu, PermaDeath, Opening_Sequence, Cinematic_Stag_travel. Other dissected classes: CameraController, SceneData, ToolItemsData, CollectableItemsData, EnemyJournalKillData, QuestCompletionData, UIManager and OnScreenDebugInfo. Process name: 'Hollow Knight Silksong.exe'.

findings.claim: The LiveSplit autosplitter is AlexKnauth/silksong-autosplit-wasm. It is written in Rust, compiled to WASM on LiveSplit's Auto Splitting Runtime (asr crate, Mono V3), and needs LiveSplit 1.8.34 or later. Official speedrun timing is LiveSplit load-removed time; the in-game timer is not accepted.
findings.detail: The autosplitter reads the GameManager and PlayerData fields listed above and does load removal from GameState, uiState, acceptingInput, sceneLoad.IsActivationAllowed, hazard respawn state and similar signals. It exposes custom variables percent, hits and deaths. Split files come from hksplitmaker.com/?game=silksong. There is also LiveSplit One Druid for Linux/Mac and a stable WASM build, silksong_autosplit_wasm_stable.wasm. hk-speedrunning rules: 'We do not accept the ingame timer'. Only the HKSRC Speed Patch (Unity Doorstop based, hk-speedrunning/Silksong.SpeedPatch, patches CourierRNGFix and DowndashTransitionFix) is legal for speedrun.com; BepInEx and all plugins are banned there. These rules do not affect Steam achievements.

findings.claim: DebugMod (hk-speedrunning/Silksong.DebugMod, v1.1.2, MIT) is the main practice and debug tool. Its complete savestates, invincibility, noclip, timescale with frame advance, and hitbox viewer make it the natural training harness. Other mods can call its savestate API.
findings.detail: Open it with F2. Savestates load in about 0.5 s, revert inventory, wishes, journal and world state, can be saved to and loaded from files, and can load automatically on death. Warning: loading a savestate overwrites the save file with no undo. It also has infinite HP/silk, skill and crest toggles, enemy HP bars, clone/kill enemies, camera zoom, a cocoon spawn preview and hazard-respawn warp. It requires Silksong.ModList and has about 85.5K Thunderstore downloads; the source folders are SaveStates, Hitbox, BindableFunctions and MonoBehaviours. Related mods: GlitchDebug (glitched-state savestates); QuickWarp (hk-speedrunning; F5 scene/transition warp menu); jakobhellermann MapWarp (right-click the map to teleport, unlock the whole map, show room borders with scene names); homothetyhk Silksong.Benchwarp (port of HK1 Benchwarp: warp to any bench or door, deployable respawn); TimerMod (trigger/scene loadless timer, F8/F9/F10); SpeedrunGym (RNG normalisation for craw dives, pogo/jump timing readouts, training dummy); PreciseSavestates. Community savestate packs are listed in Silksong-Resources. SilksongRL soft-depends on DebugMod and uses its savestate loader for episode resets; it sets game speed through DebugMod's timescale.

findings.claim: Silksong.Benchwarp's data files hold a nearly complete, machine-readable world graph for navigation without buying maps. It includes transition obstacles tied to save-data keys, which model world-state changes such as shortcuts, one-way walls and Act 3 blocks.
findings.detail: Files are in homothetyhk/Silksong.Benchwarp Benchwarp/Data/. BaseGateList.cs has 1,508 DoorData entries, each pairing (scene, gate) with a target (scene, gate), for example Abyss_01 left1 to Abyss_06 right1. Gate names follow the pattern left1/right2/top1/bot1/door1/door_fastTravelExit. BaseRoomList.cs lists rooms with MapZone, MapArea, TitledArea and Gates. SceneNames.cs has 590 scene constants. BaseBenchList.cs has 81 benches, each with SceneName, RespawnMarkerName, RespawnType and MapZone; some are conditional on PlayerData (for example Shooting Gallery depends on act3_wokeUp and Trap bench on antBenchTrapDefused). Obstacles carry ObstacleType (OneWayBreakableEntry 91, OneWayBreakableExit 30, OneWayMechanismEntry 40, OneWayMechanismExit 29, OpenAfterProgression 40, ClosedAfterProgression 17, Mask 25, Cutscene 8, TwoWayBreakable 5, TwoWayMechanism 2, Other 68) and ObstacleSeverity (LimitsRoomAccess, LimitsExitAccess, InterruptsEntry, LimitsVisibility, ModifiesSaveData). Their state keys are PersistentBoolSaveInfo(scene, objectId) (152 entries, for example Bellway_01 'Act3_Bellway_01_Breakable_wall'), PlayerDataBoolSaveInfo (51, for example churchKeeperIntro) or FSM/GameObject tests (for example 'Diving Bell States/Gone', 'Chapel Door Control').

findings.claim: The Archipelago randomizer's logic repository contains a room graph with in-room nodes, transitions to in-game gate IDs, and ability requirements in DNF form, including Act 3 state. It maps directly onto a planner for reachability and movement tech.
findings.detail: Repository: Batatvideogames/silksong-rando-ap-logic, a fork of zerounit-dev. room_graph_data.json (schema_version 3, about 5 MB) covers 514 rooms, 1,417 transitions (1,240 verified, 37 marked TODO, 23 unresolved) and 32 areas. Each room has in_game_id (for example 'Tut_01'), nodes (sub-regions), transitions (in_game_id 'left3', target '<room>@<gate>', requirement {raw, dnf}), internal connections and locations. The most common requirement atoms: dependency:location 161, capability:cling-grip 129, silk-soar 110, faydown-cloak 100, ledge-grab 52, clawline 48, scuttlebrace 38, dash 36, drifters-cloak 34, sprint 28, sharpdart 25, state:act-3 19, and pogo variants per crest (shaman, beast, hunter, architect, reaper, witch, wanderer). There are also key items (key-of-apostate and others) and Bellway/Ventrica fast-travel unlocks (item:bellway-*, item:ventrica-*). Supporting files: silksong-room-catalogue.json (518 rooms with sceneUnitWidth/Height and map-image alignment) and silksong-requirement-catalogue.json (135 predicates, 328 items). Client mod and APWorld: Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer (room_graph_data.json, map_logic.json, entrance_pool.json, rules.py, combat.py, act1/act2 scopes). The editing tool is zerounit-dev/silksong-rando-logic-manager (SQLite; map imagery from scripterswar.com/silksong/map). The data is community-made and partly unverified.

findings.claim: ItemChanger.Silksong (homothetyhk, a work-in-progress port of HK1 ItemChanger, LGPL) and jakobhellermann/silksong-data-dump give item and check locations with scene names and coordinates, shop costs, and game data tables.
findings.detail: ItemChanger.Silksong RawData/BaseLocationList/*.cs gives CoordinateLocation or ObjectLocation entries with SceneName, X/Y (Hornet's transform position) or ObjectName. Examples: Bellway Bone Bottom at Bellway_01 (69.90, 9.60); Bellway Deep Docks at Bellway_02 (86.75, 17.57), costing 40 rosaries; mask shards as 'Heart Piece' objects, for example Shadow_13 (Bilewater), Coral_19b and Peak_06. Files cover Chests, Fleas, Maps, MaskShards, SpoolFragments, Tools, SkillsAbilitiesCrests, QuestItems, Tablets and FastTravel. Its Modules/FastTravel folder handles the Bellway and Ventrica fast-travel systems. It depends on BadMagic100/ItemChanger.Core and Benchwarp, and some location data credits Br3zzly/silksong-completionist. silksong-data-dump (Rust, built on the rabex asset parser) dumps CostReference, DamageReference, CollectableItemRelicType, EnemyJournalRecord (killsRequired), ToolItem stats and Quest data from the game's dataassets bundles. Its silksong_manifests.json lists the 12 Windows depot manifests.

findings.claim: Input runs through InControl, compiled into Assembly-CSharp (HeroActions/PlayerActionSet, InputHandler.inputActions). Since Patch 4, the device layer uses Unity's Input System. A proven in-process injection method is a Harmony prefix on UnityEngine.InputSystem.Controls.ButtonControl.get_isPressed.
findings.detail: The Patch 4 beta 1.0.28954 notes say: 'Switched to Unity's Input System to improve overall controller support'. It reached stable as 1.0.29242. The silksong-tweaks analysis of 1.0.30000 found InControl in Assembly-CSharp (SharpDX.DirectInput.dll is its dependency). PlayerActionSet.Update resolves the device with 'Device ?? FindActiveDevice()' and honours IncludeDevices; KeyBindingSource reads the keyboard directly. HeroController.UpdateMoveInput reads this.inputHandler.inputActions.MoveVector, and inputHandler is set in SetupGameRefs. Gamepads are read through xinput1_3.dll and Windows.Gaming.Input.dll with no exclusive DirectInput, so an external virtual pad (for example ViGEm) or SendInput also works. The Silksong_AI project uses pydirectinput. SilksongRL overrides ButtonControl.isPressed by control name, using the default keys leftArrow/rightArrow/upArrow/downArrow, z = jump, x = attack, c = dash, which makes injection frame-synchronous with game logic. Hornet is an Addressables prefab ('Hero_Hornet', loaded by GameManager.LoadHeroPrefab).

findings.claim: I found no mod detection or save flagging. Achievements go through AchievementHandler to the platform layer (Steamworks.NET), and BepInEx itself does not block them. Community mods that block or unlock achievements exist, which implies mods alone do not disable them.
findings.detail: The DisableAchievements mod (SpaceMonkeyy86) has to Harmony-patch AchievementHandler.AwardAchievementToPlayer, AchievementHandler.UpdateAchievementProgress, MenuStyleUnlock.Unlock, GameManager.SetStatusRecordInt (keys starting with 'Rec' and ending with 'Mode', which record mode unlocks such as Steel Soul) and SteelSoulUnlockSequence.ShouldShow to stop unlocks. There are also Nexus 'Block All Achievements' (#404) and 'Unlock All Achievements' (#506, #1033) mods. A secondary guide states that achievements still work with mods. jakobhellermann's DisableSteam mod shows that without Steam, achievement unlocks do nothing and saves go to a 'default' folder instead of the Steam-ID folder. This is inferred from code and community reports; I did not find an official Team Cherry statement.

findings.claim: The only DRM is Steam's relaunch-if-not-started-by-Steam check (SteamOnlineSubsystem.IsPackaged). There is no anti-cheat or code-integrity check, and the game is also sold on GOG (DRM-free) and Xbox PC.
findings.detail: DisableSteam patches SteamOnlineSubsystem.IsPackaged to return false. BepInExPack and hk-speedrunning ship a steam_appid.txt (1030300) so the exe can run directly. The Prepatcher and SpeedPatch rewrite assemblies at load time without any detection being reported. Bundled platform SDKs: com.rlabrecque.steamworks.net (Steam), GalaxyCSharp (GOG) and XGamingRuntime/XblPCSandbox (Xbox PC). boot.config contains 'single-instance=' (Unity Force Single Instance); removing that line lets two copies run at once, about 730 MB each.

findings.claim: Saves are userN.dat files under %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Team Cherry/Hollow Knight Silksong/<SteamID>/, stored as a header plus Base64 plus AES-ECB-encrypted JSON (the same scheme as HK1). permadeathMode is 0 = normal, 1 = Steel Soul alive, 2 = Steel Soul dead.
findings.detail: The game keeps rotating backups (userX.dat.bak1) and version-tagged copies (for example userX_1.0.28561). Community tools read and write the format: martinshift.github.io/silksaver, josealmon/silksong-steel-soul-editor, Wersky/silksong-save-toolkit, moeakwak/silksong-save-editor (includes Chinese UI) and ash-005/Silksong-Save-File-reader. Steam guides describe restoring a dead Steel Soul save by setting permadeathMode from 2 back to 1 or by restoring the .bak1 file. Mod data from DataManager/SSMP lives in separate files (for example <save dir>/ssmp).

findings.claim: libTAS (Linux only) has worked with Silksong since September 2025, after fixes by Kilaye. The TASer Jarlyk published an Any% NMG TAS (52:59, TASVideos forum). I found no Windows TAS or input-replay mod for Silksong, and HK1's TasInfo tool was not ported.
findings.detail: Jarlyk's video 'Silksong TASing: Behind the Scenes' (2025-09-07) says: 'libTAS is working with Silksong (after some excellent quick fixes by Kilaye)'. libTAS Unity notes: use -force-gfx-direct and -force-opengl, and enable the Jobs, Preload operations and Async reads options; Silksong's custom Unity build makes stock symbol lookup fail. HK1's DemoJameson/HollowKnightTasInfo (and Jarlyk's fork) have no Silksong equivalent in search results. DebugMod's timescale and frame advance are the practical Windows substitute. UniTAS (Eddio0141) exists but is early-stage and untested on Silksong.

findings.claim: Two Silksong RL/bot projects already exist. SilksongRL (jimmie-jams, MIT) is a BepInEx C# plugin plus Python socket server running PPO (Stable-Baselines3); it has beaten Lace 1. Silksong_AI (MattiaPasti) is vision-only: mss screen capture, OpenCV, and pydirectinput for input.
findings.detail: SilksongRL has a hybrid observation: a 17-float vector (Hornet and boss position/velocity from Rigidbody2D, playerData.health, HealthManager.hp, cState flags facingRight/dashing/isSprinting/attacking/jumping/recoiling/Invulnerable), a one-hot of the boss FSM attack category plus 'time into attack', and a 100x100 greyscale crop of the screen. Actions are multi-discrete (move 3, look 3, jump 2, attack 2, dash 2). Episodes reset from DebugMod savestates; LethalDamagePatch prevents real deaths; BossStateLogger logs FSM states. Encounters: Lace 1 (beaten; checkpoint published), Lace 2 and Savage Beastfly (both pending). Built for BepInEx 5.4.x on .NET Framework 4.7.2. Silksong_AI detects HP by template-matching the heart slots, uses frame-skip, and has no documented boss results.

findings.claim: Several HK1 community tools have Silksong ports: DebugMod, Benchwarp, ItemChanger (work in progress), HKMP as SSMP, MapWarp, QuickWarp, the Architect level editor, the autosplitter and HKSplitMaker. HK1's Modding API, Satchel and a TasInfo equivalent do not.
findings.detail: SSMP (Extremelyd1/SSMP, by the HKMP author, LGPL-2.1+) syncs players using its own protocol over DTLS or Steam networking; the standalone server's default port is 26960. Architect (cometcake575) has about 206K downloads. Pantheon Of Pharloom (momochi003) is a Godhome-like boss rush that can help with boss practice. A randomizer based on RandomizerCore is being organized (homothetyhk/Silksong-Randomizer-Organization-Stub; SilaSong uses RandomizerCore with placeholder logic). Mod managers descended from Lumafly: Needlelight (Aarav2709).

findings.claim: Recommended decompilation and inspection workflow: open 'Hollow Knight Silksong_Data/Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll' in ILSpy or dnSpyEx; use UnityExplorer (Cinematic Unity Explorer) or FsmMaster at runtime; use AssetRipper, AssetsTools.NET or rabex for offline asset and scene extraction.
findings.detail: Because the build is Mono, decompiled C# is readable and needs no Il2CppDumper. Silksong.GameLibs provides publicized reference assemblies for compiling. jakobhellermann maintains forks of AssetRipper and AssetsTools.NET plus RustyAssetBundleEXtractor (rabex), which silksong-data-dump uses to read the game's dataassets bundles. That same route could extract per-scene TERRAIN collider geometry offline. The game uses Addressables (Unity.Addressables.dll; the hero prefab key is 'Hero_Hornet') and 2D Toolkit (TeamCherry.TK2D) for sprites, animation and tilemaps.

implications_for_bot: Architecture change: build the perception core as an in-process BepInEx 5.4.23.4 plugin (C#, netstandard2.1/net472, HarmonyX or MonoDetour, referencing Silksong.GameLibs 1.2.0-silksong1.0.30000). Read ground truth instead of relying mainly on computer vision: PlayerData (health, maxHealth, silk, silkMax, has* skills, tools/crests), HeroControllerStates, Rigidbody2D positions and velocities, HealthManager.hp, PlayMakerFSM.ActiveStateName and tk2dSpriteAnimator.CurrentClip. Stream this to the Python brain over a socket, as SilksongRL does. Keep pixel-based vision only as a fallback or cross-check.

Replace 'high-frequency CV for bullets' with per-frame enumeration of active Collider2D objects classified the way DebugMod's HitboxRender does (DamageHero, FSM 'damages_hero', and so on), plus their Rigidbody2D velocities. That gives exact projectile shape, position and velocity, so trajectory prediction becomes simple kinematics or short lookahead.

Replace 'low-frequency terrain scan' with a dump on scene load of TERRAIN-layer colliders (flagging NonSlider), NoClamberRegion, HarpoonHook anchors, TransitionPoint gates, HazardRespawnTrigger zones and Breakables. Cache the result per scene name; offline extraction with rabex or AssetRipper is also possible.

For 'learning enemy moves': log each enemy's PlayMakerFSM state transitions, clip names and durations along with the Hornet-to-enemy distance, as SilksongRL's BossStateLogger does, to build tables of tell state, time to damage and trigger range. FSM state names such as 'Counter', 'Charge' and 'J Slash' give free labels, so no action-recognition model is needed.

Navigation without buying maps: seed the world graph from Silksong.Benchwarp's BaseGateList, BaseRoomList and BaseBenchList (1,508 gates, 81 benches, 590 scenes), merged with the Archipelago room_graph_data.json (sub-room nodes plus DNF ability requirements, including state:act-3). Evaluate obstacle and shortcut state live from the PersistentBoolSaveInfo, PlayerDataBoolSaveInfo and act3_wokeUp keys (SceneData/PlayerData), so the graph updates itself as the world changes. Use ItemChanger.Silksong coordinates for items, Bellway/Ventrica stations and shops.

Inject input inside the game by patching ButtonControl.get_isPressed (proven by SilksongRL) or InControl PlayerAction state, so actions line up exactly with game frames. External SendInput or ViGEm works but adds latency and jitter, which matters for parry and dodge timing in a one-death run.

Training loop: practise on a normal-mode save using DebugMod savestates (fast resets, load-on-death, timescale for faster-than-real-time) and invincibility and hitbox tools. Run parallel instances by removing 'single-instance=' from boot.config (about 730 MB each). For the real Steel Soul attempt, disable all cheat features but keep the observer plugin.

Pin the game version: 1.0.30000 is the latest confirmed build (depot 1030301, manifest 4421626056705534276). Disable auto-update or use a separate copy downloaded with DepotDownloader. Resolve all fields and methods by name at runtime so patches such as Sea of Sorrow cause little breakage.

Achievements: nothing found says BepInEx blocks them, but before investing in full runs, test empirically by earning a cheap achievement with the plugin loaded. Do not install DisableAchievements, Block All Achievements or DisableSteam. Keep Steam running, because without Steam achievement unlocks do nothing and saves move to a 'default' folder.

Timing: the Steam speed achievement almost certainly uses the in-game timer (PlayerData.playTime), not LiveSplit load-removed time. Track playTime directly, and use the autosplitter's GameState and scene signals for segment analytics.

Steel Soul risk management: permadeathMode is 0/1/2 in encrypted userN.dat files, and the game keeps .bak1 files. The bot's watchdog can detect GameState and scene 'PermaDeath' to stop the run immediately. External save backups are technically possible but are the user's decision.
open_questions: Which exact Unity 6000.0.x version do builds after 1.0.28714 use? Check the local UnityPlayer.dll file version or Hollow Knight Silksong_Data/globalgamemanagers.

Had Sea of Sorrow or any 1.1.x patch shipped by 2026-09-28, and did it change class, field or FSM names or the achievement list? The newest community data found is dated 2026-03 to 2026-09 and is still on 1.0.30000.
Do Steam achievements actually unlock with BepInEx loaded? This is inferred from mod code and existence, not from a first-party statement; test it on a cheap achievement.
What are the exact speed-completion achievement thresholds, and do they use PlayerData.playTime? This belongs to another research topic but decides the timing source.
The github.com/silksong-modding/* repos returned 404 while the org listing still worked. Is this temporary or a move? Mirrors are at github.com/HK-Modding-Preservation.

Does DebugMod or the observer plugin cause any hitching or frame-time jitter that changes physics? Check Silksong's fixed timestep and whether game logic is tied to frame rate before relying on frame-perfect timing.

How complete and correct is the Archipelago room graph (23 unresolved and 37 TODO transitions), and does it cover every Act 3 state change the Benchwarp obstacle data models? The two need reconciling.
Is there any non-Steam-side check (for example leaderboards or telemetry) that flags modded clients? None was found.

findings.claim: Runtime is Unity Mono, not IL2CPP. The newest PC build as of 2026-09-28 is 1.0.30000 (released 2026-03-24). Sea of Sorrow is not out yet. Pin this game version.
findings.detail: The autosplitter attaches to process 'Hollow Knight Silksong.exe' using mono::Module::wait_attach(process, mono::Version::V3). BepInEx 5 works through BepInExPack_Silksong. The NuGet package Silksong.GameLibs names its versions after the game build; the newest is 1.2.0-silksong1.0.30000, published 2026-03-25, and nothing newer exists. Patch history in order: 1.0.28324 (launch, 2025-09-04), 1.0.28497 (P1), 1.0.28650 (P2), 1.0.28891 (P3), 1.0.29242/29280 (P4), 1.0.29909/29926/29980 (P5), then 1.0.30000 (2026-03-24), which only added a bench beside Pale Lake. The Sea of Sorrow wiki page (last edited 2026-09-06) still says release is 2026 with version TBD. A search snippet (not checked against a primary source) gives the Unity version as 6000.0.50f1.

findings.claim: A decompiled Assembly-CSharp exists for the launch build 1.0.28324. Field names in it match what current mods use against 1.0.30000.
findings.detail: The repo devopsdinosaur/decompiled-silksong returns 404 on GitHub now; DeepWiki still indexes it. I read a local copy that another agent had already saved to the shared scratchpad. It has 5036 files, and Constants.GAME_VERSION = "1.0.28324". InControl is compiled into it (namespaces InControl, InControl.NativeDeviceProfiles, InControl.UnityDeviceProfiles) and there are no references to UnityEngine.InputSystem. Treat it as launch-only; to check the current build, decompile the stripped DLLs from Silksong.GameLibs 1.2.0-silksong1.0.30000 with ILSpy.

findings.claim: GameManager is the root singleton, and every state pointer path starts from GameManager._instance.
findings.detail:
Pointer paths the autosplitter uses on current builds: _instance.sceneName, nextSceneName, entryGateName, <GameState>k__BackingField, <ui>k__BackingField.uiState / .menuState, <ui>k__BackingField.slotOne.State / .blackThreadImpactsLeft, <inputHandler>k__BackingField.acceptingInput, <hero_ctrl>k__BackingField.cState.{hazardDeath, hazardRespawning, recoilFrozen, isMaggoted}, <hero_ctrl>k__BackingField.transitionState, sceneLoad.<IsActivationAllowed>k__BackingField, and _instance.playerData.<field>.

Enum values:
- GameState: INACTIVE 0, MAIN_MENU 1, LOADING 2, ENTERING_LEVEL 3, PLAYING 4, PAUSED 5, EXITING_LEVEL 6, CUTSCENE 7, PRIMER 8.
- UIState: INACTIVE 0, MAIN_MENU_HOME 1, LOADING 2, CUTSCENE 3, PLAYING 4, PAUSED 5, OPTIONS 6.
- Slot state 9 = BLACK_THREAD_INFECTED.

Special scene names: Menu_Title, Quit_To_Menu, PermaDeath, Opening_Sequence, Cinematic_Stag_travel (the Bellway ride), Pre_Menu_Intro.

findings.claim: HeroController (HeroController.instance) exposes position, velocity and movement-state fields.
findings.detail:
Fields:
- Position: HeroController.instance.transform.position (DebugMod's GetHeroPos).
- current_velocity (Vector2, copied from rb2d.linearVelocity in Update).
- hero_state (ActorStates: grounded, idle, running, airborne, wall_sliding, hard_landing, dash_landing, no_input, previous).
- transitionState (HeroTransitionState: WAITING_TO_TRANSITION, EXITING_SCENE, WAITING_TO_ENTER_LEVEL, ENTERING_SCENE, DROPPING_DOWN).
- damageMode (DamageMode: FULL_DAMAGE, HAZARD_ONLY, NO_DAMAGE).
- acceptingInput, controlReqlinquished (misspelled in the source), isGameplayScene, touchingWallL, touchingWallR, wallLocked, queuedWallJumpInterrupt, isUmbrellaActive.Value (Drifter's Cloak), playerData, cState, hunterUpgState.CurrentMeterHits.
- The private field inputHandler.

Tuning values are public floats set on the prefab, so read them at runtime: RUN_SPEED, WALK_SPEED, JUMP_SPEED, DASH_TIME, DASH_COOLDOWN, MAX_FALL_VELOCITY, INVUL_TIME, INVUL_TIME_PARRY, INVUL_TIME_QUAKE, INVUL_TIME_CROSS_STITCH, INVUL_TIME_SILKDASH.

The hero is the Addressables prefab 'Hero_Hornet', loaded by GameManager.LoadHeroPrefab.

findings.claim: HeroController.cState (class HeroControllerStates) holds about 90 public bool flags, including grounded, dashing, binding, parrying and i-frames.
findings.detail:
Full list from 1.0.28324: facingRight, onGround, jumping, shuttleCock, floating, wallJumping, doubleJumping, nailCharging, shadowDashing, swimming, falling, dashing, isSprinting, isBackSprinting, isBackScuttling, airDashing, superDashing (Silk Soar), superDashOnWall, backDashing, touchingWall, wallSliding, wallClinging, wallScrambling, transitioning, attacking, lookingUp, lookingDown, altAttack, upAttacking, downAttacking, downSpikeAntic, downSpiking, downSpikeBouncing, bouncing, shroomBouncing, recoilingRight, recoilingLeft, recoilingDrill, dead, isFrostDeath, hazardDeath, hazardRespawning, willHardLand, recoilFrozen, recoiling, invulnerable, casting, preventDash, dashCooldown, backDashCooldown, nearBench, isPaused, onConveyor, onConveyorV, inConveyorZone, spellQuake, focusing, inAcid, touchingNonSlider, wasOnGround, parrying, parryAttack, mantling, mantleRecovery, inUpdraft, isToolThrowing, inWindRegion, isMaggoted, inFrostRegion, isFrosted, isBinding, needolinPlayingMemory, isScrewDownAttacking, evading, whipLashing, fakeHurt, isInCutsceneMovement.

Use the property Invulnerable, which is (invulnerable || invulnerableCount > 0), for i-frames.

Current mods confirm these names: SilksongRL reads cState.facingRight, dashing, isSprinting, attacking, jumping, recoiling and Invulnerable. hkss reads cState.onGround.

findings.claim: HeroController has built-in legality predicates and damage, respawn and resource methods that a bot can call or hook.
findings.detail:
Predicates:
- CanAttack, CanBind, CanCast, CanDash, CanDoubleJump, CanHarpoonDash, CanTryHarpoonDash, CanJump, CanNailArt, CanPlayNeedolin, CanSprint, CanSuperJump, CanThrowTool
- CanTakeDamage, CanTakeDamageIgnoreInvul
- CanInput, CanInteract, CanQuickMap, CanOpenInventory, CanBackDash, CanSoftLand

Methods:
- TakeDamage(GameObject go, CollisionSide damageSide, int damageAmount, HazardType hazardType, DamagePropertyFlags flags = None)
- IEnumerator HazardRespawn(), SetHazardRespawn(Vector3, bool facingRight)
- SetBenchRespawn(string marker, string scene, int spawnType, bool facingRight)
- AddSilk(int, bool[, SilkSpool.SilkAddSource]), TakeSilk(int[, SilkSpool.SilkTakeSource]), AddHealth, TakeHealth

findings.claim: PlayerData fields for health, silk and currency.
findings.detail:
All are on PlayerData.instance.

Health:
- health, maxHealth, maxHealthBase, healthBlue (lifeblood)
- heartPieces (mask shards). Masks progress = (maxHealthBase - 5) * 4 + heartPieces, out of 20.

Silk:
- silk (current), silkMax (base 9), silkRegenMax, silkParts, silkSpoolParts
- CurrentSilkMaxBasic (property), IsSilkSpoolBroken
- Spool progress = (silkMax - 9) * 2 + silkSpoolParts, out of 18.

Currency and cocoon:
- geo = Rosaries (HeroController.AddGeo), ShellShards
- HeroCorpseScene and HeroCorpseMoneyPool (the dropped cocoon)

Other:
- nailDamage (getter), nailUpgrades (0-4)
- isInvincible (the cheat flag, not i-frames), isInventoryOpen, disablePause, completionPercentage
- version (string)

findings.claim: How crests, tools and collectables are stored and queried.
findings.detail:
PlayerData fields:
- CurrentCrestID and PreviousCrestID (strings; for example "Cursed")
- ToolEquips (ToolCrestsData: per crest IsUnlocked, Slots List<SlotData>, each slot with EquippedTool)
- Tools (ToolItemsData, where Data = {IsUnlocked, IsHidden, HasBeenSeen, HasBeenSelected, AmountLeft})
- Collectables (CollectableItemsData), toolAmountsOverride

ToolItemType values: Skill, Red, Blue, Yellow.

Static ToolItemManager API: GetAllTools, GetUnlockedTools, GetAllCrests, GetEquippedToolsForCrest, IsToolEquipped, GetToolByName, GetCrestByName, GetAttackToolBinding / GetBoundAttackTool (which tool is bound to up, neutral or down), TryReplenishTools(bool, ReplenishMethod.Bench), SetEquippedCrest.

Reading from outside the process: the autosplitter reads playerData.Tools.RuntimeData._entries at +0x18 with _version at +0x4c. Tool entries have a 0x18 stride, the key string pointer at +0x28 and the bool at +0x30. Collectable entries have a 0x20 stride, key at +0x28 and amount at +0x30.

findings.claim: Achievement logic in the 1.0.28324 decompile: Steel Soul and Speedrunner are checked independently at game completion, so one Steel Soul run under 5 hours earns both. No code checks whether mods are installed.
findings.detail:
GameManager.CheckCompletionAchievements:
- STEEL_SOUL if playerData.permadeathMode > Off
- COMPLETION if completionPercentage >= 100
- STEEL_SOUL_FULL if both of the above
- SPEEDRUN_1 ('Speedrunner', under 5 h) if playerData.playTime <= 18000f
- SPEED_COMPLETION if 100% and playTime <= 108000f (30 h)

AchievementHandler.CanAwardAchievement only checks a whitelist per map zone. The award path does not test for mods or cheats; the only related flag is CheatManager.AlwaysAwardAchievement, which forces awards. Separately, a community guide (medium confidence) says BepInEx mods do not block achievements.

findings.claim: The 5-hour limit is measured with PlayerData.playTime. That clock counts unscaled real time only during gameplay states, and excludes loads, cutscenes, the pause menu and open inventory or map.
findings.detail:
GameManager.Update calls IncreaseGameTimer(ref sessionPlayTimer). That adds Time.unscaledDeltaTime only when:
- GameState is PLAYING, ENTERING_LEVEL or EXITING_LEVEL,
- PlayerData.instance.isInventoryOpen is false,
- and unscaledDeltaTime < 1.

The session timer is added to playerData.playTime on save.

Consequences:
- Time spent in the map or inventory is free.
- LOADING, CUTSCENE and PAUSED states are free.
- Changing Time.timeScale does not change the measured time, because the clock uses unscaled time.

This is from the 1.0.28324 decompile; confirm on 1.0.30000. The in-game clock is not LiveSplit's load-removed time; the autosplitter has its own load_removal logic.

findings.claim: Steel Soul state is PlayerData.permadeathMode (enum PermadeathModes). A death sets it to Dead and loads the 'PermaDeath' scene.
findings.detail:
PermadeathModes: Off = 0, On = 1, Dead = 2. GameManager.PlayerDead checks isPermaDead = (permadeathMode == Dead). The autosplitter treats PERMA_DEATH = "PermaDeath" as a non-play scene.

Saves are %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Team Cherry\Hollow Knight Silksong\<id>\userN.dat. They are JSON, encrypted with AES-ECB, Base64-encoded, then given a header. For bot training, use normal-mode saves plus DebugMod savestates.

findings.claim: Enemies are GameObjects with a HealthManager (field hp) and one or more PlayMakerFSMs. An enemy's type can be identified by its GameObject name with the Unity suffixes removed.
findings.detail:
HealthManager:
- public int hp; private int initHp; public bool isDead; IsInvincible (property)
- private EnemyTypes enemyType (values include Shade and Armoured)
- events OnDeath, TookDamage, StartedDead
- TakeDamage(HitInstance), Die(...), IsBlockingByDirection(int cardinalDir, AttackTypes, SpecialTypes), SetImmuneToNailAttacks, SetImmuneToSpikes

Boss GameObject names: "Lace Boss1" and "Lace Boss2 New".

enemy-behavior-api builds its ID by stripping the regex \s*\(Clone\)|\s*\(\d+\)\s*$|\s+\d+\s*$ from the name.

DebugMod's EnemyHandle reads hm.hp. It finds the templated stagger FSM with GetTemplatedFsm("stun_control").

findings.claim: Anything that hurts Hornet (enemy bodies, attack hitboxes, projectiles, spikes, lava) carries a DamageHero component or a known FSM. DebugMod's hitbox viewer shows exactly which components count.
findings.detail:
DamageHero fields: damageDealt (int, default 1), hazardType (HazardType, default ENEMY), damagePropertyFlags, canClashTink, forceParry, noClashFreeze, resetOnEnable, OnDamagedHero (UnityEvent), HeroDamagedFSM.

HazardType values: NON_HAZARD, ENEMY, SPIKES, ACID, LAVA, PIT, COAL, ZAP, EXPLOSION, SINK, STEAM, RESPAWN_PIT, COAL_SPIKES.

DebugMod CategorizeHitbox rules:
- Enemy: GetComponent<DamageHero>() or LocateMyFSM("damages_hero") or GetTemplatedFsm("hornet_multi_wounder") or CogMultiHitter, or TriggerEnterEvent whose parent has RangeAttackGroup (sand-worm areas).
- Terrain: layer == PhysLayers.TERRAIN; NonSlider.IsActive marks terrain that is not wall-slidable.
- Player attack: DamageEnemies or FSM "damages_enemy".
- Gate: trigger with TransitionPoint.
- HazardRespawn: trigger with HazardRespawnTrigger.
- Breakable: Breakable component or layer 'Interactive Object'.
- Trigger: Lever, Lever_tk2d or HarpoonHook (Clawline anchor).
- NoClamberRegion: no ledge grab. AlertRange: aggro range.

findings.claim: Physics layer numbers (enum PhysLayers) for filtering colliders and raycasts.
findings.detail:
DEFAULT 0, IGNORE_RAYCAST 2, WATER 4, UI 5, TERRAIN 8, PLAYER 9, ENEMIES 11, PROJECTILES 12, HERO_DETECTOR 13, TERRAIN_DETECTOR 14, ENEMY_DETECTOR 15, TINKER 16, HERO_ATTACK 17, PARTICLE 18, INTERACTIVE_OBJECT 19, HERO_BOX 20, GRASS 21, ENEMY_ATTACK 22, DAMAGE_ALL 23, BOUNCER 24, SOFT_TERRAIN 25, CORPSE 26, PHYSICAL_PUSHER 27, HERO_ONLY 28, ACTIVE_REGION 29, PHYSICAL_PUSH_REACT 30, ATTACK_DETECTOR 31.

For terrain, read Collider2D shapes on layer 8 with Physics2D, once per room. For threats, query layers 11, 12 and 22 plus any DamageHero every FixedUpdate. Base fixedDeltaTime is probably 0.02 s (50 Hz), inferred from the PlayMaker ScaleTime action (0.02f * timeScale). GameSettings sets targetFrameRate to 60.

findings.claim: Enemy AI runs on PlayMaker FSMs. A boss's main FSM is usually named 'Control'. Wind-up states contain 'Antic', so the active state name is a direct attack tell.
findings.detail:
SilksongRL reads GetComponents<PlayMakerFSM>().First(f => f.FsmName == "Control").ActiveStateName every step, and treats state names containing "Antic" as wind-ups. Lace 1 and 2 state prefixes: Idle, Hop, Wallcling, Refight, Pause, ComboSlash, Combo Strike, Pose, Counter, RapidSlash, Slash End, J Slash, Downstab/Dstab, Charge, Crossup, Evade, CrossSlash, Slash Slam, Multihit, Stun, P2 Shift, P3 Roar.

Animation state comes from tk2dSpriteAnimator (2D Toolkit) clip names.

enemy-behavior-api's finding: Silksong encodes an attack as an animation plus a damage collider being switched on plus velocity. The FSM action SetDamageHero appears zero times across the enemies it measured. Its attack signals are:
- SetCollider / ActivateBoxCollider2D on a child that has DamageHero
- Collision2dEvent combined with velocity (charges)
- FireAtTarget, anything named *Projectile*, SpawnObjectFromGlobalPool (spawns)
- state names matching (antic|telegraph|windup|prepare|tell)

It treats perception actions (CheckAlertRange, CheckCanSeeHero, CheckHeroPerformanceRegion) as branching. docs/silksong-playmaker-actions.txt lists all 2234 PlayMaker action types.

findings.claim: Tools exist for inspecting FSMs offline and live, and for scripting FSM edits.
findings.detail:
- FSMExpress, branch 'skong': offline FSM viewer for Silksong asset bundles.
- FsmMaster: live PlayMaker inspector and editor for HK and Silksong.
- Silksong.FsmUtil: helper methods for FSM edits.
- enemy-puppeteer: drives enemy attacks on demand, useful for generating training data.
- DebugMod: hitbox viewer, enemy HP bars, a timescale setting implemented as TimeManager.TimeControlInstance (Multiplicative), noclip, infinite HP and silk, and savestates.

findings.claim: The game ships its own scene and gate index and a full world map in memory, whether or not the player has bought any maps. A plugin can read them without purchases.
findings.detail:
SceneTeleportMap is a ScriptableObject loaded with Resources.Load<SceneTeleportMap>("SceneTeleportMap") at [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod]. GetTeleportMap() returns Dictionary<sceneName, SceneInfo{SceneFileHash, MapZone, List<string> TransitionGates, List<string> RespawnPoints}>.

GameManager.instance.gameMap.mapZoneInfo can be walked as ZoneInfo, then .Parents (ParentInfo), then .Maps (MapCache.sceneName) to list every mapped scene. DebugMod's UnlockAllMaps does exactly this and then calls gameMap.SetupMap().

GameMapScene holds alternate sprites and colours, each gated by a PlayerDataTest, so the map art itself changes with world state.

PlayerData.scenesVisited and PlayerData.scenesMapped are HashSet<string>.

findings.claim: Per-room world state (levers, shortcut doors, breakable walls) lives in SceneData.instance.PersistentBools and PersistentInts, keyed by (sceneName, id). Some of it lives in PlayerData bools instead.
findings.detail:
PersistentItemDataCollection<TValue,…> stores a Dictionary<scene, Dictionary<id, PersistentItemData<T>>>, where PersistentItemData = {SceneName, ID, Value, IsSemiPersistent, Mutator}. API: GetValueOrDefault(scene, id), TryGetValue, SetValue, ResetSemiPersistent. SceneData also has geoRocks.

The component PersistentBoolItem / PersistentIntItem (base PersistentItem<T>) sets ID to the GameObject name by default, and SceneName to GameManager.GetBaseSceneName(scene).

Examples:
- ("Slab_02", "slab_jail_lever")
- ("Crawl_02", "aspid_sealed_gate_stone")
- ("Hang_06", "bank_door")

Examples stored as PlayerData bools: openedSongGateDocks, UnlockedDustCage, UnlockedMelodyLift, HasSlabKeyA/B/C.

Semi-persistent items (for example respawning breakables) reset through GameManager.ResetSemiPersistentItems(). DebugMod savestates serialize PlayerData and SceneData with JsonUtility.

findings.claim: Act 2 and Act 3 changes are driven by PlayerData flags. They mostly toggle GameObjects inside the same scene; a few rooms have distinct '_Destroyed' scene variants.
findings.detail:
Flags: act2Started; blackThreadWorld (the Act 3 world; DebugMod has a toggle for it); act3_wokeUp.

Objects are gated by these components: ActivateIfPlayerdataTrue/False, DeactivateIfPlayerdataTrue/False (and ...Delayed), DeactivatePlayerDataTest, TestGameObjectActivator (fields activateGameObject, deactivateGameObject, playerDataTest, questTests, equipTests, entryGateWhitelist/Blacklist), PlayerDataTest, PlayerDataTestResponse, SetPosIfPlayerdataBool, PersistentBoolItemResponder, BlackThreadState.

- Jump = Z
- Attack = X
- Dash = C (sprint)
- Cast = A (Bind / heal)
- SuperDash = S (Clawline / harpoon)
- DreamNail = D (Needolin)
- QuickCast = F (silk skill / tool, with direction)
- QuickMap = Tab
- Taunt = V
- Inventory = I; inventory pages M, Q, J, T

findings.claim: The input backend changed in Patch 4 (1.0.29242, 2025-11-07) to Unity's Input System. InControl still wraps the actions, and keyboard reads now go through UnityEngine.InputSystem, where Harmony injection is proven to work.
findings.detail:
Patch 4 notes: 'Switched to Unity's Input System to improve overall controller support.' An API inspection of build 1.0.30000 (2026-08) still finds InControl compiled into Assembly-CSharp. There, PlayerActionSet.Update resolves Device ?? FindActiveDevice(); IncludeDevices restricts which devices count (InputDevice.Null means none); KeyBindingSource.GetState reads the keyboard directly. The game loads xinput1_3.dll and Windows.Gaming.Input.dll, and not dinput8.

SilksongRL, which targets current builds, injects actions with [HarmonyPatch(typeof(UnityEngine.InputSystem.Controls.ButtonControl), "get_isPressed")]. The prefix overrides __result when __instance.name is one of "leftArrow", "rightArrow", "upArrow", "downArrow", "z", "x" or "c".

DebugMod postfixes InputHandler.Update and uses legacy UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown for its own hotkeys, so both input backends are active.

External SendInput or virtual-XInput injection should work but needs window focus and is not documented for Silksong.

findings.claim: Working reference projects exist for a C# plugin plus external brain, and for exporting game state.
findings.detail:
SilksongRL: C# BepInEx mod plus Python socket server running PPO. It has beaten Lace 1. It hooks HeroController.Awake and HealthManager.Awake with Harmony, steps on Time.fixedTime intervals, and resets episodes with DebugMod savestates at raised timescale. Its observation vector: hero position and Rigidbody2D velocity, playerData.health, cState flags, boss position, velocity and hp, and the boss FSM state.

hkss-data-export-bus: HTTP on 8080, WebSocket on 9091, TCP on 9090, NDJSON output at 5-10 Hz. It exports health, position, velocity, grounded, dashing and attacking, and hooks HeroController.TakeDamage, HealthManager.TakeDamage and HeroController.EnterScene(enterGate).

Also: Silksong Neural Smart (24-input raycast sensor network), enemy-behavior-api and enemy-puppeteer.

findings.claim: SSMP's Resource JSON files (entity-registry.json, save-data.json) are leftovers from Hollow Knight 1 (HKMP). They are not Silksong data.
findings.detail: save-data.json has keys playerData, geoRocks, persistentBoolItems (2282), persistentIntItems and bossStatueCompletionVariables. It references HK1 fields such as vesselFragments and soulLimited, 285 'Crossroads_' scenes, and has no silk, silkMax, hasHarpoonDash or blackThreadWorld. entity-registry.json lists HK1 enemies (Crawlid, Vengefly). Do not use either as a Silksong enemy list or world-state list.

findings.claim: Useful gameplay facts from the launch-build code for state tracking.
findings.detail:
- Built-in CheatManager has static flags (Invincibility, NailDamage, IsCheatsEnabled, CanChangeEquipsAnywhere, and others). Useful for training only.
- DebugMod savestates capture PlayerData, SceneData (with semi-persistent bools and ints), hero position and facing, and the Hunter crest meter. They reload through GameManager.BeginSceneTransition with EntryGateName 'dreamGate'. This gives deterministic resets for learning a room or boss.
- HeroControllerStates also has a string-to-field cache (fieldCache / boolFieldAccessOptimizer), so PlayMaker FSMs query cState flags by name.

implications_for_bot: Build the perception layer as an in-process BepInEx 5 plugin (Mono) that reads HeroController, PlayerData, SceneData and HealthManager directly. Stream the data to the Python brain over a socket, as SilksongRL and hkss-data-export-bus do. Screen-based computer vision is optional: the game's own state is exact. The launch code shows no mod check gating achievements.

Pin the game to build 1.0.30000 and turn off Steam auto-updates, or pin a beta branch. Build the plugin against Silksong.GameLibs 1.2.0-silksong1.0.30000. Sea of Sorrow (pending in 2026) could change scenes, fields and offsets.

Plan one run for both achievements. STEEL_SOUL and SPEEDRUN_1 are awarded independently at completion, so a Steel Soul run with playTime ≤ 18000 s earns both. Track the budget with PlayerData.playTime plus GameManager's live session timer. Time in the map or inventory, the pause menu, loads and cutscenes does not count. This is from the 1.0.28324 code; re-check it on 1.0.30000.

Treat safety as the main objective. Stop on hp ≤ threshold, keep cState.Invulnerable windows in the model, and avoid hazards entirely: DamageHero.hazardType other than ENEMY means spikes, lava and similar, which still deal damage. Read permadeathMode every frame and treat Dead as a terminal state. Train with DebugMod savestates, the timescale setting and infinite HP on normal-mode saves.

Threat detection: each FixedUpdate, enumerate active Collider2D objects that have DamageHero, the 'damages_hero' or 'hornet_multi_wounder' FSMs, or are on layers ENEMIES (11), PROJECTILES (12) or ENEMY_ATTACK (22). Read each object's Rigidbody2D velocity and gravityScale to predict projectile paths exactly. Read terrain once per room from TERRAIN (8), NonSlider, NoClamberRegion and HarpoonHook colliders.

Enemy model: key enemies by their GameObject name with the Unity suffixes stripped. Log (FSM name, ActiveStateName, tk2d clip, distance and relative position to Hornet, time until a DamageHero collider switches on). 'Antic' states and enemy-behavior-api's TelegraphFor output give the wind-up tells. Learn a table of state, then reaction window, per enemy. Enemy hp comes from HealthManager.hp.

Navigation: seed the graph from APWorld entrance_pool.json (632 gate edges across 310 scenes) and room_graph_data.json (connections within rooms, with requirement DNFs and state:act-3). Fill gaps at runtime from TransitionPoint.TransitionPoints and SceneTeleportMap. None of this needs purchased maps. Store edges as (scene, gate, predicate over PlayerData and SceneData.PersistentBools and blackThreadWorld), so opened shortcuts and Act 3 blockades are handled.

Fast travel: represent Bellway and Ventrica as special edges to the scenes in FastTravelScenes. Gate them on the Unlocked*Station / Unlocked*Tube flags, UnlockedFastTravel, the rosary balance (PlayerData.geo) and the Act 3 exceptions (First Shrine Ventrica blocked, Terminus disconnected). Beastling Call (UnlockedFastTravelTeleport) is a warp to the last Bellway used.

Actions: decide at the HeroActions level (Jump, Attack, Dash, Cast = Bind, QuickCast = silk skill/tool, SuperDash = Clawline, DreamNail = Needolin, Taunt, QuickMap). Before issuing an action, check HeroController.Can*() (CanDash, CanBind, CanHarpoonDash, CanThrowTool, and so on) to avoid wasted inputs. For injection, prefer a Harmony prefix on UnityEngine.InputSystem ButtonControl.isPressed (proven by SilksongRL) or a virtual Input System device. Use OS-level SendInput only as a fallback that needs window focus.

Skill and loadout tracking: read the has* flags, ToolItemManager.GetEquippedToolsForCrest(CurrentCrestID), ToolItemsData AmountLeft and silk / silkMax / healthBlue. A healing decision needs silk ≥ bind cost and HeroController.CanBind(); take the bind cost from the combat research topic.
open_questions: Have HeroControllerStates, HeroController, SceneTeleportMap and the playTime/achievement code changed between 1.0.28324 (the decompile) and 1.0.30000? Check by decompiling the Silksong.GameLibs 1.2.0-silksong1.0.30000 DLLs with ILSpy.

After Patch 4, how exactly does InControl sit on Unity's Input System? Is KeyBindingSource backed by UnityEngine.InputSystem.Keyboard, and do gamepads go through InputSystem devices or InControl native profiles? This decides whether a virtual Input System gamepad is enough for injection.

Is entrance_pool.json complete? It has 632 transitions and 310 scenes against about 565 scenes in total. Some one-way drops, door_* special gates, memory scenes and Act 3-only paths may be missing. Dump TransitionPoint.targetScene/entryPoint for every scene at runtime and compare.
Exact runtime values of INVUL_TIME, DASH_TIME, DASH_COOLDOWN and RUN_SPEED on the Hero_Hornet prefab, and the real physics timestep (0.02 s is inferred).
Can the speedrun target coexist with the Steel Soul risk budget? Pick a route (NMG any%) under 18000 s of playTime, with margin; this belongs to the routing topic.
Release date of Sea of Sorrow. Will its update change existing scenes, benches or achievement code? Plan to freeze the game version until the bot finishes.
Licensing and publication status of the zerounit room catalogue JSON (518 rooms with inGameId), and whether it is kept in sync with the APWorld 'mapper-json' source.

findings.claim: The time-limited achievements are 'Speedrunner' (finish in under 5 hours) and 'Speed Completion' (100% completion and finish in under 30 hours). Steel Soul is 'Finish the game in Steel Soul mode'. Steel Heart is 100% plus finishing in Steel Soul.
findings.detail: Steam global unlock rates at fetch time: Speedrunner 4.9%, Speed Completion 4.0%, Steel Soul 3.8%, Steel Heart 3.0%, Completion 16.9%. The user's '速通成就' most likely means Speedrunner (5h). Speed Completion requires Act 3, because 7% of completion is Act 3-only. Achievements are awarded only after an ending (hollowknight.wiki Completion page).

findings.claim: The Speedrunner and Speed Completion limits use the save file's in-game timer, not real time. Pause and inventory stop it.
findings.detail: The Steam guide 3569566036 says pausing pauses the in-game timer. In Steam thread 800093831719700538, two players confirm that the pause menu and inventory stop the timer; no one cites decompiled code. The Speed Completion guide says it 'goes by ingame time'. Loading screens and cutscenes are not confirmed: one low-quality site says loads are excluded and cutscenes counted. hollowknight.wiki's achievement page did not specify. The speedrun.com boards use load-removed real time (LRT, realtime_noloads) as the primary timing and have in-game timing disabled, so leaderboard times are not the achievement clock.

findings.claim: The fastest ending is Weaver Queen: beat Grand Mother Silk (GMS) at the end of Act 2 and choose Bind. Human players report getting Speedrunner and Steel Soul together in one Steel Soul run with the first ending.
findings.detail: Endings: Weaver Queen (beat GMS, bind), Twisted Child (beat GMS while wearing the un-upgraded Cursed Crest), Snared Silk (Silk and Soul wish plus Needolin on GMS, which leads to Act 3), Sister of the Void (Lost Lace, Act 3 true ending), Passing of the Age (after Sister of the Void plus Mister Mushroom's wish). The Any% rule is 'Beat the game with any ending'; every Any% split file ends at 'Grand Mother Silk'. A Chinese player reported getting 速通+钢魂 with 一结局 (the first ending) at 3h59m, with save-load and backups used. Steam guide 3581413736 ('Easy route to get SteelSoul/Speedrunner') finishes around 3:50.
