The Nov 2025 speedrun.com news post attributes the cloakless Key route through Wormways to Remto's WR.

findings.claim: The Mist is a randomized maze and contains enemies. It cannot be solved with a fixed path and needs Needolin plus reading lightmoth cues.
findings.detail: From oxbox's Mist guide (Google Doc 1wGYxE_mDfZ_Qtbs6cvcTZggTFPYTBJ9Rijno0VZkNdA). There are 8 possible rooms (M1 to M8). You enter a random room and each exit leads to another random room, with one exit correct. Playing Needolin near lightmoth groups reveals the correct exit; lightmoth spawn combinations are random. Wrong exits use up a strikes counter (IncorrLeft); running out sends you back to the maze entrance. Voiding out, dying or saving resets the whole maze. Wraiths spawn from room 2 onward, up to 2 per room early and up to 5 later, and take 6 needle hits each. There is a midway 'crossing' at which the score jumps to 5; the final room exits right. 'Room juggling' was patched out as of version 1.0.29139. Human Steel Soul routes call Sinner's Road, the Mist and Phantom the hardest or 'very RNG' section.

findings.claim: Human achievement routes finish in about 3.5 to 4 hours of in-game time, and a bot has several times the world-record time as slack.
findings.detail: The 5h limit is 18,000 s in-game time. NMG WR (48 min) is 16% of it; the latest-patch best (52.6 min) is 17.5%. Reported human times: SteelSoul/Speedrunner guide 3581413736 at about 3:50 (hourly plan: Hour 1 Moss Grotto to Hunter's March with Silk Spear, Swift Step, Drifter's Cloak, Straight Pin, Fractured Mask; Hour 2 Shellwood, Bellhart, Greymoor with Cling Grip, 6 masks, Reaper Crest, Thread Storm, Needle 1, Widow; Hour 3 Sinner's Road, Mist, Phantom, Cogwork Dancers; Hour 4 Vaults, Pale Oil, Clawline, melodies, High Halls, Lace 2, GMS). Bahamut post: about 3.5h. Sina Steel Soul run: 3h59m. SqrtiLv Bilibili route: '7 masks, 12 silk', described as high error tolerance and ample time. Speed Completion: 30h against a 4.5h 100% WR, about 6.6 times the WR time. Rough split from Act 1 IL WRs: Act 1 is about 27 of 50 min for the Bell route.

findings.claim: Risky segments for a no-death run, per guides: High Halls arena ('the hardest part of the whole speedrun route'), Lace 2, Grand Mother Silk, Cogwork Dancers, Trobbio, Last Judge or Phantom and the Mist, Widow, Bell Beast, Lace 1, and the multi-wave arenas (Greymoor, Shellwood, Whispering Vaults, Clawline, Hunter's March).
findings.detail: The Sina Steel Soul run lists: 高庭连战 (High Halls gauntlet) as the hardest part, Lace, and 双大锤 (two hammer enemies). Steam guide 3581413736 names Bell Beast, Lace, Phantom and the Mist, and Trobbio (bring 7 masks and Needle 3); it cheeses High Halls with Cogfly plus Tacks. Guide 3569566036 calls Cogwork Dancers 'probably the hardest section'. Patch-dependent numbers: Last Judge's death explosion was reduced from 3 to 2 damage in 1.0.30000. Moorwing and Sister Splinter were made easier in 1.0.28497. Many out-of-bounds and push-through-floor bugs were fixed up to 1.0.30000.

findings.claim: Steel Soul safety tools: the Fractured Mask tool (260 Rosaries from Mottled Skarr in Hunter's March) survives one lethal hit, and save-and-quit near death prevents the 'DEFEATED' state.
findings.detail: Fractured Mask: a lethal hit leaves Hornet at 1 mask instead and the tool shatters; it repairs free at a bench. It does not stop a two-instance multi-hit (for example Muckroach's Maul, claw traps). Since 1.0.29242 it also protects against volt hazards. The wiki notes that exiting and reloading when near death can prevent 'DEFEATED'; you reload at the last bench. Some fights do not delete the save on defeat: First Sinner, Shakra, Garmond and Zaza, Elegy of the Deep memories. Other Steel Soul differences: Shell Satchel replaces Dead Bug's Purse (both 1%); Skynx replaces Styx; the 'A Vassal Lost' wish (Summoned Saviour boss) and Steel Seer Zi in Blasted Steps are exclusive. Steel Soul unlocks after one ending, or with Up, Down, Up, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right on the Extras menu. Save files live in %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Team Cherry/Hollow Knight Silksong/<id>/userN.dat, with .bak files; Chinese achievement runners report backing up save files during runs.

findings.claim: Wardenfly capture: after Cling Grip and before Faydown Cloak, Wardenflies in Deep Docks, Greymoor and Bilewater can capture Hornet and send her to The Slab, where she loses her Needle and cloak and has only kick attacks until she escapes.
findings.detail: The Bell route leaves Greymoor and Deep Docks before Cling Grip, so it mostly avoids this. The Key route passes through Greymoor after Cling Grip. Wardenflies do not spawn if Bell Beast was skipped. Capture is not a death, but it costs a lot of time and is dangerous in Steel Soul. The 1.0.28497 patch fixed staying cloakless after escaping The Slab.

findings.claim: How the world changes by act. Act 1 ends when Hornet enters the Citadel after beating Last Judge (Grand Gate) or Phantom (Grand Bellway). Act 2 opens Citadel areas and the Ventrica tram fast travel but leaves Act 1 zones largely unchanged. Act 3 needs the Silk and Soul wish plus Needolin on GMS (the Snared Silk ending), then reloading the save.
findings.detail: Act 3 changes: various passages blocked and others opened; Bone Bottom mostly destroyed except its Bellway; a Survivor's Camp in The Marrow where the Flea Caravan was; Wormways overrun with Plasmium; Void Masses spawn; Void-afflicted enemies and bosses get stronger movesets and HP, deal 2 masks per hit and drain silk. Destroying Void Masses clears a room permanently. The Ventrica at the First Shrine is blocked. Loam dies; Shakra's spar and Greyroot's second quest become inaccessible; two journal entries vanish (secondary sources). Up to 93% completion is reachable before Act 3; the Act 3-only 7% is: a Mask upgrade, the Pale Steel needle, Pin Badge, Pale Nails, Shaman Crest, Silk Soar, Everbloom. Weaver Queen and Twisted Child respawn you at the last save with the boss revived, so that file can continue. Snared Silk moves the file into Act 3.

findings.claim: Skips depend on the game version. As of 2026-09 the Steam patches are: 1.0.28324 (release, 2025-09-04), 28497 (2025-09-12), 28650 (09-22), 28714, 28891 (10-14), 29242 (11-07), 29315, 29909, 29926, 29980, and 1.0.30000 (Patch 5, 2026-03-16, latest PC). Sea of Sorrow (free expansion) is announced for 2026 but was listed as not yet released.
findings.detail: Relevant fixes: 1.0.28497 fixed staying cloakless after the Slab escape, removed Faydown 'float override', fixed a down-bounce float, fixed a Lace 1 tool-deflect softlock in Deep Docks, and nerfed Moorwing and Sister Splinter. 1.0.28650 fixed a Shaman-bind softlock at bottom transitions and cocoons in unreachable places. 1.0.28714 has two Unity builds; the newer one makes some glitches harder. 1.0.28891 fixed unintended air dash and double jump, a Scuttlebrace wall jump, and a Grand Gate opening softlock. 1.0.29242 switched to Unity Input System (affects input injection) and fixed Fractured Mask against volt hazards. 1.0.30000 lets Silk Soar pass top scene exits, fixes many out-of-bounds cases, lowers Last Judge's explosion from 3 to 2, and adds a bench before the Flea Caravan at Pale Lake. Runners downpatch with the Steam console: download_depot 1030300 1030301 <manifest>, plus a steam_appid.txt containing 1030300. NMG runs mostly use 1.0.28324 (Cloakless) or 1.0.29242 / 1.0.28891 (Cloak). NMG-banned techniques (triple jump, float sprint, silkspear storage, Voltvessel wallbreak, Trobbio skips, QWJI storage, Deep Docks bridge hazard respawn, Fourth Chorus Skip Skip, out of bounds, menu storage, room dupes) and allowed ones (pogo endlag cancel, beast boost, bind dash refresh, tool and pin pogos, lever skips, queued walljump interrupts, map drops) matter only for leaderboards, not achievements.

implications_for_bot: Aim for one Steel Soul file that ends with Weaver Queen (beat GMS at the end of Act 2 and Bind). That can unlock both Steel Soul and Speedrunner. Act 3 world modelling is only needed if Speed Completion or Steel Heart (100%) is added later.

Use the Bell Route (Judgement) on the latest patch (1.0.30000) as the default plan. Its navigation is fixed, whereas the Mist route needs a randomized maze solved in real time with Needolin, lightmoth cues and up to 5 wraiths per room. Encode the route as the any-bells.json split sequence plus safety detours.

Time budget: the world record uses about 16% of the 5h in-game limit, and humans finish in 3.5 to 4h. Plan for a route of about 2 to 3h in-game time. Spend the rest on safety: extra masks and silk, needle upgrades (Pinmaster Plinney in Bellhart; Pale Oil in Whispering Vaults), Fractured Mask (260 Rosaries in Hunter's March), Faydown Cloak, strong tools (Thread Storm, Straight Pin, Sting Shard, Cogfly plus Tacks for High Halls), and farming Rosaries for Bellways and bell benches.

Pause and inventory stop the achievement timer (medium confidence). The bot can pause for heavy planning or model inference without using the 5h budget. Still log in-game time from the save or PlayerData, not wall-clock time.

Build a save-and-quit abort into the combat controller: pause and quit to menu when HP is critical or the Fractured Mask has broken, then reload at the last bench. Rest at benches before every boss or arena so the Fractured Mask refreshes. Account for two-instance multi-hits that bypass the mask.

Model world state with progress flags such as PlayerData booleans or autosplitter split IDs: bells rung (5), Act2Started, levers and shortcuts, Bellway and Ventrica stations unlocked, benches bought, melodies collected. The silksong-autosplit-wasm Mono-dissector field list and its about 167 split IDs are a ready-made oracle for route progress.

Map and navigation: Act 1 zones barely change in Act 2 (new Citadel areas and Ventrica fast travel). Act 3 changes much more (Bone Bottom destroyed except its Bellway, Wormways full of Plasmium, the First Shrine Ventrica blocked, Void-buffed enemies dealing 2 masks, Void Masses). Keep a separate graph layer per act so edges can be enabled or disabled by flags.

Avoid Wardenflies in Deep Docks, Greymoor and Bilewater between getting Cling Grip and getting Faydown Cloak. Capture strips the Needle and could end a Steel Soul run. The Bell route order already mostly avoids them.

Pin one exact game build and keep version-tagged data (boss damage, hitboxes, enemy behaviours). Patches changed boss damage (Last Judge 3 to 2) and fixed softlocks on the route (Grand Gate opening, Lace 1 tool deflect). If Steam auto-updates, especially when Sea of Sorrow arrives, the learned models may no longer match the game.

Do not depend on glitches or frame-tight skips (Fourth Chorus Skip, pogo skips, AG menu storage and noclip). Achievements do not need them and they add risk. Fight or path around instead, and use Steam guide 3581413736 and the Bilibili Steel Soul routes as the base for a safety-first route.

Use the vichisuki Bell Route savestates with DebugMod as a training curriculum: one savestate per boss or arena lets the bot practise each risky segment in normal mode before a Steel Soul attempt. Mods are only for training; the achievement run itself should probably be unmodded (see open questions).
open_questions: Exactly what does the achievement in-game timer count? Loading screens, cutscenes, the full-screen map, and time spent in the menu before a save-quit are unconfirmed. This needs a decompile of GameManager/PlayerData.playTime and the achievement check.
Do achievements unlock on a downpatched build run outside the Steam library (steam_appid.txt)? Do BepInEx/DebugMod or other loaded mods block or invalidate achievements?

Can the pause menu be opened in every state (hit-stun, grabs, boss cutscenes, during a lethal hit)? And is save-quit always safe in Steel Soul, i.e. with no window where the death is already committed?

Is Sea of Sorrow released at the moment the bot runs, and does it change base-game maps, completion % or achievement conditions? No release was confirmed in the sources checked (last Steam announcement is Patch 1.0.30000, 2026-03-16).
Segment-level target times for the Bell route were not found (the ComSOB spreadsheet link was not retrieved). They would help set per-segment time budgets.
Why cloakless was release-patch-only in Nov 2025 is unclear, given a Cloakless run on 1.0.30000 dated 2026-07-02. It is irrelevant if the bot takes Drifter's Cloak.

No primary source was found that fully lists which passages are blocked or opened in Act 3, or how Bellway stations change. The wiki only says 'various passageways'. Needed only for Speed Completion or Steel Heart.

The Rosary economy for the chosen route is unknown: total Rosaries needed for the Simple Key, Bellway stations, bell benches, Fractured Mask (260) and needle upgrades, and where to farm them efficiently on the latest patch.
Is the 'Weaver Queen' ending enough for Steel Soul? Supported by a Chinese player report and wiki wording that achievements need 'an ending', but no official statement was found.

findings.claim: Every HK/Silksong combat bot with a documented win read ground-truth state or reward from inside the game (mod or memory read). None succeeded on pixels alone.
findings.detail: Mod-state bots: hollow_knight_bot (HK1) beat Hall of Gods Attuned hornet1, gruz_mother, marmu, false_knight and soul_warrior, and reached 43% on gorb. SilksongRL (Silksong) beat Lace 1. Pixel bots that still needed the game's internals: seermer/HollowKnight_RL needed the Satchel + EnemyHPBar mods with a custom bar colour to read boss HP. ailec0623/DQN_HollowKnight switched to reading HP with kernel32 memory reads. OC-STORM (ICLR 2026) captured the screen at 9 FPS but 'developed a modding plugin that logs when the Knight either hits an enemy or is hit' to get its reward signal.

findings.claim: SilksongRL is the only working public Silksong RL bot. It is a BepInEx 5.4.x + Harmony mod that reads HeroController, HealthManager and PlayMakerFSM, sends the state over a socket to SB3 PPO, and has beaten only Lace 1.
findings.detail:
Observation (LaceEncounter.cs) is 21 floats: hero.transform.position; Rigidbody2D.velocity; hero.playerData.health (max 10); the boss HealthManager, matched by hm.name=='Lace Boss1', with hm.hp (max 250); boss position and velocity; and a one-hot over 11 attack categories. The categories come from PlayMakerFSM.ActiveStateName prefixes: Idle/Hop/Wallcling, ComboSlash/Pose, Counter, RapidSlash, 'J Slash', Downstab, Charge, Evade, CrossSlash/'Slash Slam', Stun, Multihit.
Actions are MultiDiscrete [3,3,2,2] (move, look, jump, attack), plus a dash bit in the Extended space.
A step fires when Time.fixedTime - last >= StepInterval (default 0.1 s). The game is not paused while Python thinks, so latency varies by machine.
Reward: boss HP lost ×2, hero HP lost ×15, win +500, death -100, plus distance shaping.
Status: Lace 2 and Savage Beastfly are still pending. Requires Debug Mod. MIT licence.

findings.claim: On current Silksong, SilksongRL injects input with a Harmony prefix on UnityEngine.InputSystem.Controls.ButtonControl.get_isPressed. It overrides keys by name, so it only works with the default keyboard bindings.
findings.detail: ActionManager.cs: [HarmonyPatch(typeof(ButtonControl), "get_isPressed")]. When RLManager.isAgentControlEnabled is true it returns __result for key names leftArrow, rightArrow, upArrow, downArrow, z (jump), x (attack) and c (dash). The README warns that non-default bindings make the agent press the wrong buttons. This works because Patch 4 (1.0.29242, 6 Nov 2025) switched the game to Unity's Input System.

findings.claim: Silksong's input stack depends on the game version. Before Patch 4 it was InControl only. Since 1.0.29242 Unity's Input System is the default, and the old method can still be chosen in Advanced controller settings.
findings.detail:
Team Cherry: 'Switched to Unity's Input System to improve overall controller support... The previous input method remains accessible via Advanced Settings.'
InControl internals, per a decompile study: InputHandler.inputActions is a HeroActions : PlayerActionSet. HeroController.UpdateMoveInput reads this.inputHandler.inputActions.MoveVector. KeyBindingSource.GetState reads the keyboard directly; DeviceBindingSource reads the assigned device. SharpDX.DirectInput.dll ships beside the game.
The HK1 bot's approach (attach an InControl InputDevice subclass and AddBinding(new DeviceBindingSource(...)) to inputActions) should port to the InControl path. Whether it still reaches gameplay under the new Input System on the latest patch is unverified.

findings.claim: hollow_knight_bot is the most mature HK1 reference design. It runs in lockstep by blocking Unity's main thread on a socket read: hold buttons 67 ms, sample state, then wait for the next action.
findings.detail:
Settings: FrameSkip=4 at 60 fps, so ActionHoldSeconds = 4/60, timed on Time.unscaledTime.
Actions: 21 discrete moves. Buttons persist across steps, so jump height, heals and nail-art charge emerge naturally. Cast is bound to quickCast and Focus to cast, because one shared button made spell timing 'mushy' and made Focus unreachable.
Observation: 18 normalised scalars plus a one-hot of the boss FSM state. Checkpoints are therefore boss-specific. Policy is RecurrentPPO (LSTM).
Reward: +0.03 per boss HP, -1 per mask lost, win +10 (+1 per mask left), death -5, small per-step penalty.
Throughput: about 54k steps/h for one instance. With 4 headless instances (-batchmode -nographics, frame cap 60) about 184k steps/h. Application.runInBackground = true is required, because Unity pauses unfocused apps and background instances would freeze.
The mod drives resets itself from boot (menu walk, statue). It records replays with postmortem (last ~5 s before each death) and reaction-to-projectile-by-distance analyses.

findings.claim: Faster-than-real-time via Time.timeScale has fidelity traps. Hit-pause (GameManager.FreezeMoment*/SetTimeScale coroutines) runs on unscaled time, and hollow_knight_bot turned timescale training off after trying it.
findings.detail:
HK1 bot: it hooked TimeController.SetTimeScaleFactor so the multiplier re-applies after every game write, and divided FreezeMoment rampDown/wait/rampUp by k. It raised the batchmode frame cap to 60k so each frame still spans 1/60 of a game second, and scaled the action hold to ActionHoldSeconds/k. Then on 2026-08-25 it disabled timescale training: 'train.py forces 1x'. --timescale was kept only for a replay 'speed-fidelity gate'.
Silksong DebugMod: speed control uses TimeManager.TimeControlInstance (Multiplicative). TimeManager.UpdateTimeScale refuses scales above 1 unless CheatManager.IsCheatsEnabled, which DebugMod patches to return true. It IL-patches FreezeMoment*/SetTimeScale MoveNext to multiply Time.unscaledDeltaTime by the custom scale.
SilksongRL's authors say the DebugMod timescale works for training because its steps run in FixedUpdate.

findings.claim: Silksong DebugMod (hk-speedrunning) supports freeze, frame advance, timescale edit, hitbox viewer, invincibility, and file-based savestates that restore full PlayerData and SceneData.
findings.detail:
Frame advance (BindableFunctions/Time.cs AdvanceFrame): set Frozen=false, yield WaitForFixedUpdate, set Frozen=true. The step granularity is therefore one physics tick.
SaveState.Save: JsonUtility round-trips PlayerData.instance and SceneData.instance, plus semiPersistent bools and ints and toolAmountsOverride. Load reloads the scene via Addressables.LoadSceneAsync("Scenes/<name>"). It is a scene-reload restore, not a memory snapshot: enemies restart from scene load.
Other features: auto-load on death, 'Toggle Act 3 world state', a hitbox visualiser colour-coded by type. It needs BepInEx and Silksong.ModList. The companion QuickWarp scene selector exists. Community savestate packs are organised by category, including Bosses. Neither tool is legal for speedrun.com submissions, which does not matter for Steam achievements.

findings.claim: Silksong is not deterministic enough for open-loop input replay: 'Silksong has particularly unstable RNG', and even the TAS tools only partly fix it. A route bot must be closed-loop.
findings.detail:
SilkTasInfo (Jarlyk, libTAS on Linux): RNG sync hooks specific Random call sites. That is done for v28714 and v28324 only, and 'there's still some rng that's not being caught yet'. The game ships a custom Unity build, so libTAS must find its internal functions by signature ('hi Silksong').
hkrl (HK1) found that GG_Ghost_Gorb, GG_Ghost_Xero and GG_Grimm_Nightmare 'do not reproduce their own recordings (same script, same seed)'. Suspected causes: wall-clock reads, iTween Time.deltaTime accumulation, AudioPlayRandom.
A ViGEm gamepad replayer for HK1 reports 1-3 px drift from Unity physics and is 'not ideal for long full-level runs'.

findings.claim: Porting the game into a fast deterministic simulator (hkrl's hksim, HK1) is possible per boss but a very large effort that fails silently. It is not a realistic route for a whole-game Silksong bot.
findings.detail:
hksim is a C port of the PlayMaker runtime, the actions and Unity's Box2D 2.3.1 fork. It is built from decompiled code plus runtime dumps, verified against a game mod (HKOracle), and needs an RTX 30-series or newer GPU.
The roster is 135 arenas over 57 scenes. 66 action types are still unported. There are open damage-registration mismatches (a spell deals 35 in the game vs 30 in the sim) and movement mismatches. The repo was created 2026-09-24 and publishes no win rates.

findings.claim: Pixel-based RL has only reached moderate win rates on single bosses, after hours of training per boss. That is far below the reliability Steel Soul needs.
findings.detail:
seermer/HollowKnight_RL (DQN with Double, Dueling, n-step, DrQ, Noisy nets, SVEA; 1280x720 windowed; keyboard; window must keep focus): 6/10 then 5/10 wins vs Hornet. It removed dash as 'way too hard to use'. Failure modes it hit:
- collapse to no-op, fixed by updating less often
- an infinite-reward environment bug
- a per-step negative reward teaching the agent to die fast

OC-STORM (Cutie segmentation from 12 annotated masks per boss; 100k samples ≈ 3.1 h at 9 FPS): Hornet Protector 100%, Mantis Lords 83.3%, Mage Lord 48%, Pure Vessel 13.3% at 400k samples.
MattiaPasti/Silksong_AI (mss + template matching + HSV + pydirectinput + SB3 PPO) reports no results.

findings.claim: Celeste RL lessons: a lockstep mod bridge is 85x faster than a TAS-file bridge, and RL without demonstrations completed zero rooms. Imitation on a new room erased skill on the old one.
findings.detail:
celeste-rl (Everest mod hooked into CelesteTAS playback):
- about 2,600 frames/s including resets, vs about 30 steps/s over HTTP
- savestate reset about 4 ms
- no demonstrations: 0 room completions in 50,369 episodes / 6M transitions
- Room 1: 74.8% route success (target 99%)
- teaching Room 2 by imitation 'erased almost all of its Room 1 skill'
- policies scoring 98.0-98.5% from the canonical start dropped to 59.7-84.6% from held-out starts

CelesteTAS itself uses frame-locked 60 Hz logic plus Speedrun Tool savestates. Unity's variable timestep lacks that property.

findings.claim: In 2D platformer AI competitions, planning with a forward model beat learning: an A* agent that simulated game physics won the 2009 Mario AI Competition.
findings.detail: Robin Baumgarten built a forward model and planned in real time with A*. No agent without A* beat the heuristic baseline. For navigation and traversal, a physics or motion model plus search or scripted routes is the proven approach. Learned policies suit reactive combat better.

findings.claim: Reading PlayMaker FSMs gives exact attack labels and selection rules for free. Existing bots feed the boss's FSM state into the policy rather than learning tells from pixels.
findings.detail:
SilksongRL: LogBossStates=true logs every PlayMaker FSM state change and animation of the boss, with boss HP and state durations ([BossStates] lines).
hollow_knight_bot: an F4 discovery logger records FSM transitions, arena extremes and projectile candidates (e.g. Hornet's 'Needle'). parse_discovery.py turns those logs into registry values.
Tools: FSMExpress 'skong' branch (static Silksong FSM viewer), FsmMaster (live FSM inspector and editor, supports Silksong), Silksong.FsmUtil.
Inference: logging (FSM state, distance to hero, HP, timestamp) gives labelled data for 'which attack at what range', and can auto-label frames to train a pixel-based tell recogniser.

findings.claim: External input injection works for Unity games, but has pitfalls: focus is required, Python libraries add default delays, gamepads are polled, and ViGEmBus is retired.
findings.detail:
SendInput (e.g. pydirectinput, which uses scan codes) worked for HK1 and Silksong bots, but only with the game window focused. Unity Input System's default backgroundBehavior is ResetAndDisableNonBackgroundDevices.
pydirectinput has PAUSE = 0.1 by default, which sleeps 100 ms after every call; set pydirectinput.PAUSE = 0 or pass _pause=False.
Unity Input System polls XInput pads at 60 Hz by default on Windows (InputSystem.pollingFrequency), adding up to about 16.7 ms for a ViGEm or vgamepad virtual X360 pad. Keyboard input arrives as events.
ViGEmBus was retired and archived on 2 Nov 2023. The last release still works on Windows 10/11.
The Interception driver is unnecessary (Silksong has no anti-cheat filtering injected input). It has a known bug where only KbdClass0-9 IDs work, so input dies after repeated device reconnects.

findings.claim: Screen-capture options: DXGI Desktop Duplication via DXcam or BetterCam sustains 240-300 fps at 1080p. In-engine capture avoids the compositor and the UI.
findings.detail:
DXcam: 239.19 fps average on a 240 Hz output (5900X + 3090), vs python-mss 75.87 and D3DShot 118.36. It has DXGI and WinRT (Windows Graphics Capture) backends. Targets above 120 fps are 'resource heavy'.
BetterCam: 283-298 fps at 1920x1080 (RTX 4070), with CuPy or torch-CUDA output. Its author advises targets of 160 fps or less because of Python and OS scheduling.
Windows Graphics Capture delivers frames at the compositor rate; MinUpdateInterval behaves oddly below 1 ms.
SilksongRL's in-engine ScreenCapture blits BuiltinRenderTextureType.CameraTarget before the UI into a RenderTexture, then downsizes to 84x84 greyscale with ReadPixels.

findings.claim: Estimated reaction latency: an external capture, YOLO and SendInput loop takes roughly 30-70 ms at 60 fps. An in-engine mod reacts within 0-1 frame, and lockstep removes decision time entirely.
findings.detail:
Components:
- compositor/capture: about 1 display refresh (16.7 ms at 60 Hz, 7 ms at 144 Hz), plus a 1-3 ms copy
- inference: YOLO11n at 640 px takes 1.5 ms on T4 TensorRT10 (YOLO11s 2.5 ms); on CPU it is 56.1 ms with ONNX or 13-18 ms with OpenVINO on an i7-10850H
- injection: under 1 ms
- game: up to 1 frame for the Update poll (plus up to 16.7 ms for a pad at 60 Hz polling) and 1 frame to render the effect

The totals are an engineering estimate built from these component figures, not a measured end-to-end number for Silksong. Unity Time.captureDeltaTime makes game time advance a fixed dt per frame regardless of wall time. It does not affect Time.unscaledTime, so the same hit-pause caveat applies.

findings.claim: Detection training data can be auto-labelled from game data instead of hand-labelling; public HK datasets are small and hand-labelled.
findings.detail:
Existing HK datasets are hand-annotated on Roboflow from YouTube frames at 640x640 with YOLOv8/11 (lucasmr19; GaTech Hollowknight_V2 with classes like hornet, husk_warrior, knight).
LeagueAI generated synthetic training images by compositing game sprites onto backgrounds, with labels created automatically. It achieved higher precision on more classes than hand labels.
OC-STORM needed only 12 masks per boss, about 10-15 minutes of annotation, using Cutie propagation.
For Silksong, DebugMod's type-coded hitbox viewer and SilkTasInfo (enemy HP, position and velocity; hitbox/other-hitbox display) show that a mod can enumerate colliders. Projecting them to the screen with Camera.WorldToScreenPoint yields per-frame boxes and classes. That projection step is an inference.

findings.claim: Steam achievements still unlock with BepInEx mods loaded, so an in-engine mod does not rule out earning Steel Soul or speed achievements.
findings.detail:
Silksong awards achievements through AchievementHandler.AwardAchievementToPlayer and AchievementHandler.UpdateAchievementProgress. Mode unlocks go through GameManager.SetStatusRecordInt with keys 'Rec*Mode'.
The Silksong.DisableAchievements mod exists precisely to Harmony-block those calls and SteelSoulUnlockSequence.ShouldShow, which implies modded games do award them by default. Community threads say the same.
Mod-specific side effects need checking, for example DebugMod forcing CheatManager.IsCheatsEnabled true during timescale updates.

findings.claim: Training harnesses must never touch a real Steel Soul save. Existing projects suppress saving and cancel lethal damage during training.
findings.detail:
SilksongRL:
- SaveSuppression stops all game saves after a savestate loads ('in-memory state is training state')
- LethalDamagePatch prefixes PlayerData.TakeHealth, zeroes the killing blow when pd.health - amount <= 0, and flags a reset; the same idea as DebugMod's load-on-death
- AutoStart boots straight into the encounter savestate

hollow_knight_bot snapshots the save directory on every start (newest 10 kept). Windows multi-instance runs share one save slot in both projects. SilksongRL gives each Linux/Proton instance its own prefix of about 300 MB.

findings.claim: Game state can be read without injecting a mod: the LiveSplit Silksong autosplitter reads Mono memory by class and field name, so it survives patches better than raw offsets.
findings.detail:
AlexKnauth/silksong-autosplit-wasm (asr Mono/Unity helpers) reads PlayerData fields (e.g. hasSilkSpecial, hasNeedleThrow, health), the scene name, load state and hero position. It ships a Silksong-Mono-dissector.TXT field list and works in LiveSplit ≥1.8.34 on Windows with no extra permissions. DQN_HollowKnight used kernel32 ReadProcessMemory for HP in HK1.
This read-only path suits HP, silk, skills, scene and position tracking. It cannot provide input injection or FSM internals as easily as a mod.

findings.claim: Imitation and behaviour cloning have been tried on Silksong and suit bootstrapping. VPT-style inverse-dynamics labelling can turn unlabelled run videos into action data.
findings.detail:
TP2-IA-SilkSong, a fork of SilksongRL, logs game state together with real player inputs and trains a classifier that predicts human actions (behaviour cloning) instead of running RL.
VPT trains an inverse dynamics model on a small labelled set, then labels about 70k hours of unlabelled video to pretrain a policy. Speedrun VODs could be used the same way.
celste-rl showed that demonstrations were necessary: zero completions without them.

findings.claim: Mods are built against a specific game version, and Silksong has had several patches. Pin the game version, since depot manifests for downpatching are published.
findings.detail: Patch 4 (1.0.29242, 6 Nov 2025) swapped the input system. Patch 5 (1.0.29926, March 2026) was billed as the 'last significant update' before the Sea of Sorrow expansion; Fextralife also lists 1.0.30000. SilkTasInfo builds per patch (v28324, v28714) by replacing Assembly-CSharp.dll. hk-speedrunning/Silksong-Resources keeps a 'Manifests' document of depot manifest IDs for every version, plus BepInEx 5.4.23.4.

findings.claim: Frame rate may change Silksong's physics and trick consistency, and speedrun rules allow frame caps of 50 fps or more. The bot's FPS should be fixed and identical in training and in the real run.
findings.detail: Speedrun rules: a third-party cap is allowed if it is at least 50 fps and not changed during the run. Community reports: Healless Fourth Chorus skip is easier at 60 fps; some top runners cap at 300 or 600 fps. Steam users also claim odd i-frames, flying-enemy AI and pogo/dash behaviour above 60 fps, but other users contest this and it is unverified.

findings.claim: Some 'Silksong AI' repos are unverified or AI-generated scaffolds with no evidence of working, and should not be used as prior art.
findings.detail: owlclockl/Silksong-Neural-Smart: a PR from arena-ai-coding-agent[bot] claiming a 24-input neuroevolution net and a 110 ms human-latency ring buffer; no code evidence. duyichen312-bit/hollow_knight_agent: an LLM 'Spatial ReAct' with 60 FPS capture; no metrics. Note that LLM round-trip latency (hundreds of ms) is incompatible with combat reaction.

findings.claim: No public project has automated a full HK1 or Silksong playthrough (exploration, progression and combat). All prior art covers single boss arenas reset from savestates or Godhome statues.
findings.detail: hollow_knight_bot and hkrl target Godhome arenas. SilksongRL targets 3 encounters with 1 beaten. The randomizer logic efforts are incomplete. SilaSong has 354 locations, all with logic 'TRUE'. The Archipelago logic (zerounit-dev/silksong-rando-ap-logic) still lists The Mist, Red Memory and Verdania as UNMAPPED. The map and progression layer will have to be built mostly from scratch.

implications_for_bot: Architecture: build a BepInEx 5 + Harmony mod. It reads HeroController, PlayerData, HealthManager, PlayMakerFSM.ActiveStateName and colliders, and injects input in-engine; the decision process talks to it over a local socket. Every documented win used mod or memory state. Pure pixel RL peaked around 50-60% vs HK1 Hornet, which is nowhere near Steel Soul reliability.

If a vision stack is still wanted (e.g. to 'look' at terrain), have the mod generate the labels. Project collider bounds and the FSM state onto the screen to train a small YOLO11n or s model. Always keep the mod's ground truth as the safety check.

Enemy behaviour: log (FSM state, state duration, hero-boss distance, HP, phase) per boss with a LogBossStates-style hook while you play with invincibility on. Read FSMs statically with FSMExpress (skong branch) or FsmMaster. Encode tells as an FSM-state to dodge-window table rather than learning them from pixels.

Combat controller: start with scripted or rule-based responses keyed on FSM state, then add learning. Train per-boss PPO/RecurrentPPO or behaviour cloning from DebugMod savestates, with lethal-damage interception and save suppression during training. Evaluate from varied start states, because canonical-start success overestimates.
Navigation: use a scene/transition graph plus scripted or A*-planned routes over a motion model. RL without demonstrations failed completely in celeste-rl.
Determinism: never rely on open-loop input replay. Silksong RNG and Unity timing drift. Every segment must be closed-loop with state checks and recovery.

Input path is version-dependent. Pin the game version (depot manifest) and the input mode. The current game (Patch 4 and later) uses Unity Input System; the ButtonControl.get_isPressed patch works for keyboard names. The legacy InControl path needs an InputDevice + DeviceBindingSource. If injecting externally, set pydirectinput.PAUSE=0, keep the window focused, and raise InputSystem.pollingFrequency (only possible from a mod) or use the keyboard instead of a virtual pad.

Training speed: prefer lockstep (block the main thread per step, or use Time.captureDeltaTime) over raising Time.timeScale. If timescale is used, scale FreezeMoment/SetTimeScale unscaled-time coroutines, respect TimeManager.UpdateTimeScale's CheatManager gate, and validate with a 1x fidelity gate as hollow_knight_bot did.
Fix and log the FPS cap (e.g. 60 or 120 with a hard limiter) and use the same value in training and in the real run. Set Application.runInBackground=true for multi-instance training.

Safety: run training only on copies or savestates, never on the real Steel Soul slot. Disable all training-only patches (lethal-damage cancel, invincibility, timescale) in the final run, and verify that no mod flips cheat flags that could affect the save or achievements.
open_questions: Does the in-game playtime used by the speedrun achievement use scaled game time (e.g. PlayerData.playTime += Time.deltaTime)? If so, lockstep, freeze or timescale control would change the relation between wall time and the timer, and the user must decide whether such use is acceptable. This needs a decompile of the current Assembly-CSharp.

On the latest patch (1.0.29926 / 1.0.30000), is keyboard gameplay input routed through Unity Input System ButtonControl, through InControl KeyBindingSource, or both? Which hook covers all actions, including menus and tool or skill buttons?
Does Silksong run under -batchmode -nographics for headless multi-instance training, as HK1 did?
What are Silksong's Time.fixedDeltaTime and the Input System update mode (Dynamic vs Fixed)? Is movement or i-frame behaviour frame-rate dependent (the community claims are unverified)?
Does loading DebugMod or using CheatManager.IsCheatsEnabled overrides set any persistent cheat or tamper flag in the save that could block achievements? A clean final-run mod set should be verified.
Does Steel Soul mode have to be unlocked by finishing the game first (the SteelSoulUnlockSequence and 'Rec*Mode' status records suggest so)? If so, the bot must complete one normal run first.

No project reports the per-boss success rates Steel Soul needs (~99%+ for every boss and hazard). How many training hours per boss does it take to get there for Silksong's ~40+ bosses? This is an open risk.
Will the Sea of Sorrow expansion patch break mods built against current Assembly-CSharp or change achievements, so that the game version must be frozen?

findings.claim: Health: Hornet starts with 5 masks and can reach 10. There are 20 Mask Shards and 4 shards make +1 max mask. Completing a mask fully heals. Act 1 has 6 shards, Act 2 has 10, Act 3 has 4, so an Act-2 ending run can reach at most 9 masks.
findings.detail: Hornet heals at benches, hot springs, spa pools or with Bind. Plasmium (lifeblood-like) masks are temporary and are removed when sitting at a bench. Early (Act 1) shards: (1) bought from Pebb in Bone Bottom for 300 rosaries; (2) lower Wormways behind a breakable wall in front of the Simple Key door, reached via Mosshome; (3) in the Marrow to Deep Docks passage, Cling Grip recommended; (4) above the Seamstress in Far Fields, needs Drifter's Cloak; (5) centre of Shellwood, platforming behind a breakable wall; (6) east Weavenest Atla, needs Needolin and a breakable wall. Act 2 shards include: Cogwork Core west gauntlet (after Cogwork Dancers), the Whispering Vaults box puzzle, Jubilana for 750 rosaries, and the Savage Beastfly wish reward. PlayerData math: masks = (maxHealthBase-5)*4 + heartPieces.

findings.claim: Damage taken comes in 1, 2, 1+1 or 1+1+1 masks. Nearly every boss attack and all boss contact damage is 2 masks, so with 5-6 masks the bot is 2-3 hits from death.
findings.detail: Wiki classes: 1 mask for basic enemies and spikes. 2 masks for bulky enemies and falling boulders. 1+1 (two quick hits) for flurries, steam and grabs. Examples: Last Judge all attacks and contact 2 (fire 2, or 1 with Magma Bell). Moorwing contact 2, Quick Swipes 1+1. Cogwork Dancers contact and blades 2, Configuration/Clash 1+1. Lace (Cradle) pin swings 1+1. Grand Mother Silk attacks 2, Silk Web 1+1+1 (cutscene grab), spike platforms 1. Bell Beast, Fourth Chorus hands, Sister Splinter, Choir Clapper: 2. Community rule of thumb: any armed enemy or anything not much smaller than Hornet has 2-mask attacks. The Barbed Bracelet doubles almost all damage taken (floor(dmg*mult)), so never equip it in a Steel Soul run.

findings.claim: Hazard damage is fixed in code by hazard type: SPIKES 1, ACID 1, LAVA 2, COAL 1, COAL_SPIKES 1, ZAP 1, STEAM 2, RESPAWN_PIT 0. Any attack flagged Flame deals 2 and any flagged Void deals 2 plus a silk drain.
findings.detail: Source: HeroController.TakeDamage(GameObject go, CollisionSide, int damageAmount, HazardType, DamagePropertyFlags). HazardType enum: NON_HAZARD, ENEMY, SPIKES, ACID, LAVA, PIT, COAL, ZAP, EXPLOSION, SINK, STEAM, RESPAWN_PIT, COAL_SPIKES. DamagePropertyFlags: SilkAcid, NonLethal, Flame, Void, Acid, Self. Magma Bell halves damage >1 from lava or flame (2 becomes 1), then goes on a 5 s cooldown. It also adds 2 s to the 0.7 s grace period on hot floors. Frost (Mount Fay): once the frost meter is full, 1 mask is lost every 1.75 s and it can kill (TakeFrostDamage, canDie true). Grabs and chomps use DoSpecialDamage, which skips Magnetite Dice. Code is from launch build 1.0.28324 and should be re-checked on 1.0.30000.

findings.claim: Environmental hazards still damage Hornet during post-hit invulnerability and during parry or Sharpdart i-frames. i-frames only block ENEMY, EXPLOSION and NON_HAZARD damage, so being knocked back into spikes, lava or steam after a hit costs extra masks.
findings.detail: The early-return guard in TakeDamage only fires when !CanTakeDamage() and (not invulnerable, or hazardType is ENEMY, NON_HAZARD or EXPLOSION). A SPIKES/LAVA/ACID/STEAM hit while cState.Invulnerable, or while parryInvulnTimer > 0, therefore goes through. The wiki independently says Sharpdart can still be hit by spikes during its i-frames. After a hazard hit, DieFromHazard runs and Hornet respawns at the last HazardRespawnMarker with invulnerability of INVUL_TIME*2+0.3 s. If another hazard hits within 0.5 s of a hazard respawn, the respawn point resets to the scene entry gate (death-loop guard). Pogoing onto spikes is safe when downTravelling and the spike object has a TinkEffect.

findings.claim: The post-hit invulnerability window is about 1.0 s in vanilla (inferred), 1.3 s with Weighted Belt. The '0.45 s i-frames / 0.35 s hitstun' figure that appears in web searches is from an unrelated itch.io game and must not be used.
findings.detail: Mechanism: StartRecoil(impactSide, dmg) calls StartInvulnerable(INVUL_TIME). With Weighted Belt the time is multiplied by WeightedAnkletDmgInvulnMult, 1.3 per the wiki (+30%). The Wanderer Crest wiki page says Weighted Belt raises invincibility to 1.3 s, which implies a base of about 1.0 s. INVUL_TIME is a serialized field, so its exact value is not in the decompile. During the hit-freeze (DAMAGE_FREEZE_DOWN/WAIT/UP) the code sets playerData.disablePause = true, so the bot cannot pause at the moment of impact. A second hit during invulnerability can extend the window. Weighted Belt also halves knockback. The 0.45/0.35 s numbers come from 'Into The Core' (Bullet Hell Jam 6).

findings.claim: Sources of invulnerability: needle parry/clash (0.25 s), Cross Stitch stance and counter, Sharpdart dash, pogo down-spike (2 physics steps, 10 for the long variant), Witch Crest down/run-slash intangibility, and Warding Bell during Bind. Swift Step (dash and sprint) has no i-frames, and Bind itself has none.
findings.detail: Code timers: parryInvulnTimer = INVUL_TIME_PARRY (NailParry), INVUL_TIME_CROSS_STITCH, INVUL_TIME_SILKDASH (SilkChargeEnd, i.e. Sharpdart), INVUL_TIME_QUAKE. Pogo: DOWNSPIKE_INVULNERABILITY_STEPS=2 and _LONG=10 ignore ENEMY damage unless the DamageHero has noBounceCooldown. Other flags: cState.evading (Scuttlebrace evade) and cState.whipLashing (Witch). damageMode HAZARD_ONLY/NO_DAMAGE is set by FSMs during some skills. Sharpdart has a vulnerable startup before the dash. Cross Stitch blocks any damage, including contact, but cannot trigger while Hornet is already invulnerable. Community mods such as 'SilkSong Shadow Dash' exist only to add dash i-frames, which supports the no-i-frames reading.

findings.claim: Bind costs 9 silk and heals 3 masks in 1.37 s (1.2 s heal plus a 0.17 s flash), in the air or on the ground. Getting hit before the flash cancels it and wipes ALL silk on the spool.
findings.detail: With Warding Bell, damage during Bind is negated and the bell deals 9/14/20/25/31 damage by Crafting Kit level. The Bind is still cancelled, but unconsumed silk is kept. A platform vanishing under Hornet also cancels Bind. Durations (base / Multibinder / Injector / both): other crests 1.37/1.94/0.89/1.3; Beast 1/1.2/0.67; Witch 1.05/1.33/0.8/1.03. Multibinder does two 0.8 s binds of 2 masks each (4 total); if interrupted after the first half, those 2 masks are kept. Injector Band is -40%. Reserve Bind gives one free Bind per bench rest. Crest variants: Beast gives fury lifesteal (1 mask per needle hit, max 3; fury 4.7 s, -2.35 s per hit taken). Witch gives roots lifesteal (max 3) and needs enemies close. Shaman slams to the ground first, so no air heal. Architect UP+Bind is Craft Bind (refills tools, no heal, 0.5 s faster). Reaper's post-bind silk fragments last 10 s and end on damage. Cursed Crest cannot heal. When plasmified, Bind heals less. Muckmaggot infestation makes Bind clear the infestation instead of healing.

findings.claim: Silk rules: the spool holds 9 at the start and 18 at most (18 Spool Fragments, 2 per strand; Spool Extender adds 3). Each needle or Clawline hit gives 1 silk, and multi-hits give no extra except Hunter Needle Strike. Silk skills cost 4 (3 with Egg of Flealia at full HP) and Challenge costs 1.
findings.detail: Silk Hearts (3 total, from Bell Beast, The Unravelled and Lace in the Cradle) regenerate up to 1 strand per heart: first strand after 1.45 s, then 3.9 s each. Weavelight adds a 4th regenerating strand and cuts the times to 0.95 s and about 2.5 s. Silk Spindles give 2 per hit, webs 2, cocoon 9. Druid's Eye gives 1 strand per 2 hits taken (2 with Druid's Eyes); a 1+1 hit counts as two hits, a 2-mask hit as one. Silk is lost as follows: all of it when hit during Bind or Rune Rage; 3 when grabbed by a Wraith; 2 from Void damage (Everbloom prevents this); Muckmaggot water -1 every 0.5 s and -1 every 7 s while infested; Clawmaidens (Citadel) siphon it. Early spool fragments: breakable wall above Bone Bottom, central Deep Docks burning-floor room, Greymoor balloon shaft above Shakra's bench (needs Cling Grip), Frey 270 rosaries, Weavenest Atla, the Slab.

findings.claim: The down-slash (pogo) shape differs per crest: Wanderer hits straight down (best for pogo), Reaper sweeps a wide half-circle with a stall (easy but slow), Hunter and Architect dive diagonally (hard to pogo), Beast pounces in a delayed curved arc (hardest), Witch whips slightly angled with brief intangibility on hit, and Shaman fires a downward wave that lifts Hornet even on a miss.
findings.detail: Attack speed relative to Hunter: Wanderer +34% (narrow, about 40% less area; 2% crit for 3x damage when silk is at least 9); Reaper -23% with +48% knockback; Shaman -22% with about 109% more range and +40% silk-skill damage. Hunter focus: +30% after 6 hits, +50% after 12 (Patch 3 values), resets on damage. Beast fury: +25% damage and +20% range/speed. A successful pogo refreshes mid-air abilities. The pogo target must be under the crest's hitbox: straight below for Wanderer, offset diagonally in the facing direction for Hunter, Reaper and Architect. Delver's Drill can stand in as a straight-down attack for Hunter, Beast and Architect.

findings.claim: Parry and clash: most enemy attacks with a white trailing line can be parried with a normal needle swing (not tools), giving 0.25 s invulnerability. Multi-hit attacks are parried by continuing to attack. Deflecting a projectile with the needle makes it harmless and resets the attack cooldown.
findings.detail: Deflected projectiles can damage enemies. Some bosses parry-riposte for 1+1 when struck in their guard stance: Lace (Deep Docks and Cradle), Phantom, Second Sentinel, Lost Lace. Beast fury does not pierce these. Cross Stitch (from Phantom) is a universal counter: 4 hits at 0.75x needle damage each. Boss stagger depends on hit count, not damage (Last Judge needs 14 hits). While staggered a boss can take at most 75 damage. Fourth Chorus, The Unravelled, Cogwork Dancers and Clover Dancers stagger by damage instead.

findings.claim: Fractured Mask (Blue tool, 260 rosaries from Mottled Skarr in Hunter's March, or looted from his corpse) survives any one lethal hit, is repaired free at a bench, and is the universal Steel Soul pick. The wiki lists exceptions where it breaks on the first hit of a 1+1 and Hornet then dies: Muckroach Maul, Wraith grab, Slubberlug grab, and the claw traps in Greymoor and the Mist.
findings.detail: Code (PlayerData.TakeHealth): if health minus damage is 0 or less and the mask is equipped with AmountLeft > 0, damage is clamped to health-1 and AmountLeft is set to 0. For multi-hit attacks it breaks on the last hit. Patch history: 1.0.29242 (Patch 4) fixed it not protecting against volt hazards and stopped it breaking on the first hit of a combo. A later patch added an allowFracturedMaskBreak argument to DoSpecialDamage. Because of these changes the exception list should be re-checked on 1.0.30000. A Steam Steel Soul thread also warns that Forebrothers lava/environment damage can get past it.

findings.claim: Other defensive tools, with numbers: Warding Bell, Magma Bell, Weighted Belt, Magnetite Dice, Injector Band, Multibinder, Reserve Bind and Plasmium Phial.
findings.detail: Warding Bell: Blue; free pickup from a dead Smelt Shoveller in lower Far Fields next to the lower Deep Docks entrance. Magma Bell: 2-fire damage becomes 1, protects against all fire explosions since Patch 5, but per the wiki not against Trobbio's fireworks (TheGamer says it helps with Trobbio; the wiki disagrees). Weighted Belt: Yellow; 160 rosaries from Mort at Pilgrim's Rest; +30% post-hit invulnerability, half knockback, max fall speed 30 to 38. Magnetite Dice: Yellow; block chance starts at 0% and rises 2.02% per hit taken up to 10.1%, resets after a block; cannot block stationary hazards or DoSpecialDamage grabs, and blocks only the last hit of a 1+1. Injector Band: Whiteward. Multibinder: 880 rosaries from Frey in Bellhart after the My Missing Courier wish. Reserve Bind: from Second Sentinel after the Final Audience wish. Plasmium Phial: Wormways; +1 temporary mask per use; 9 of them trigger plasmification, which regenerates 1 mask every 6 s.

findings.claim: Loadouts reported by the community for Steel Soul all use the Fractured Mask; the crest choice varies between Reaper, Wanderer and Hunter.
findings.detail: TheGamer: Reaper Crest (reach, and post-bind silk speeds up the next heal); avoid Beast and Witch for healing because they need enemies nearby; Magma Bell for Fourth Chorus, Last Judge and Trobbio; Tacks. Steam 'Steel Soul 100% under 30h' guide (updated 2025-12-02): Wanderer ('the Quick Slash of this game'), Fractured Mask immediately, Warding Bell early, Magma Bell for Forebrothers, Wisp Thicket and Underworks lava; reload if HP drops below 4 in the Mist. A Chinese player earned Speedrunner and Steel Soul in one run (3h59m, Ending 1) with Wanderer + Druid's Eye + Warding Bell, Thread Storm and Cross Stitch, taking the Mist route. Silksongwiki.com: Reaper early, Warding Bell then Magma Bell. A Steam thread adds Injector Band + Fractured Mask or Reserve Bind, Weighted Belt, and poison Tacks against bosses.

findings.claim: Save-and-quit is the Steel Soul safety valve: pausing and choosing Quit to Menu, then reloading, puts Hornet at the last bench with full HP and does not count as a death. Death itself saves the 'Dead' state immediately, so killing the process after dying does not save the run.
findings.detail: The wiki says that exiting and reloading when close to death keeps the slot from being marked DEFEATED. Steam threads and Chinese guides use this routinely ('SL', or quitting at one hit from death). Code: GameManager.PlayerDead calls SaveGame at once, and with permadeathMode == Dead it loads the 'PermaDeath' scene. Pause is disabled during the damage-freeze of every hit (StartRecoil sets playerData.disablePause = true) and in some scripted states. Patch 4 made ReturnToMainMenu refuse when pausing or save-quit is disabled, and Patch 5 added a save-and-quit fade-in delay. Community guides say pausing stops the in-game timer.

findings.claim: Steel Soul changes the world only slightly. Losing to First Sinner, Shakra, Garmond & Zaza, or inside Elegy of the Deep memories does not end the run.
findings.detail: Other differences: Styx is dead and Skynx buys Silkeaters for 46-154 rosaries. The Blasted Steps Silkeater room is replaced by Steel Seer Zi and the wish 'A Vassal Lost', which leads through NPC Sula to the Summoned Saviour boss in Bonegrave (500 HP, Void attacks 2 and 1+1, gives no silk; reward Growstone). Dead Bug's Purse is replaced by Shell Satchel, and the Queen's Egg delivery wish is gone. One Materium item is required for 100% in Classic mode but not in Steel Soul. Unlock: finish the game once, or enter Up,Down,Up,Down,Left,Right,Left,Right on the Extras page. Save code name: PERMA / MODE_STEEL / STEEL_SOUL.

findings.claim: The Act 2 Weaver Queen ending (defeat Grand Mother Silk and Bind her) is enough for both Steel Soul and Speedrunner, so no Act 3 content is needed and both can be earned in one run.
findings.detail: GameManager.CheckCompletionAchievements awards STEEL_SOUL if permadeathMode > Off, COMPLETION and STEEL_SOUL_FULL (Steel Heart) at 100%, SPEEDRUN_1 if playerData.playTime ≤ 18000 s (5 h), and SPEED_COMPLETION at 100% with playTime ≤ 108000 s (30 h). Chinese players report both achievements together after Ending 1 at 3h59m and 2h46m. Steam global unlock rates: Steel Soul 3.8%, Steel Heart 3.0%, Speedrunner 4.9%, Speed Completion 4.0%, Weaver Queen 41.0%. The Snared Silk ending leads into Act 3 and removes the Weaver Queen ending.

findings.claim: Boss requirements for the Weaver Queen ending: Moss Mother, Bell Beast, Lace 1, Widow, one of Last Judge or Phantom (via the Mist), the three melody gates (Cogwork Dancers, Trobbio, the Forum gauntlet), Lace 2 and Grand Mother Silk. Fourth Chorus, Moorwing and Sister Splinter are commonly skipped.
findings.detail: Steam 5-hour any% guide (Mist route): Moss Mother, Bell Beast, Lace I, Fourth Chorus, Moorwing, Sister Splinter (skipped with a skip), Widow (gives Needolin), Phantom, Cogwork Dancers, Trobbio, Lace II, Grand Mother Silk; Last Judge avoided. Alternatives: Last Judge (Blasted Steps) or Phantom (reached through the Mist) — either opens the Citadel. Three melodies are needed: Architect (past Cogwork Dancers), Vaultkeeper's (Trobbio), Conductor's (the Forum/High Halls enemy gauntlet). Skips: Moorwing by rescuing 5 fleas so the Flea Caravan moves to Greymoor (it returns black-threaded in Act 3); Sister Splinter by a jump-and-glide skip into the post-boss room for Cling Grip; Fourth Chorus with sprint-jump + float + heal-stall + float + sprint. Optional and avoidable: Savage Beastfly, Skull Tyrant, Great Conchflies, Forebrothers, Groal, First Sinner, Summoned Saviour, all Act 3 bosses. Bosses killed in Act 1-2 are not re-fought in Act 3.

findings.claim: The most dangerous required content for a Steel Soul Act-2 run is the High Halls Forum gauntlet, the Cogwork Dancers, Lace 2 in the Cradle, and either Last Judge or the Mist. Grand Mother Silk is rated relatively easy.
findings.detail: Forum gauntlet: 13 waves of Choristor, Reed, Envoy, Choir Bellbearer, Clawmaiden (silk theft; destroy its core), Minister and Maestro, ending with 2 Choir Clappers (230 HP each; mallet, contact and silk-slam all deal 2; they alternate attacks). Chinese runners call it the hardest part of the run, dying to the final two hammers. Garmond & Zaza help if beaten in the Whispering Vaults; Shakra helps after the Trail's End wish. Cogwork Dancers: HP 190+190, 220+220, 220+220, then 180; 4 phases; contact 2, Configuration/Clash 1+1; called the hardest section by the Steam any% guide; cheese is to cling to a corner wall with Ascendant's Grip. Lace 2: 800 HP, pin swings 1+1, parry-riposte; Cross Stitch counters her. Last Judge: 720 HP, all attacks 2, fire, floor breaks away, death explosion 2 (3 before Patch 5). The Mist: 7 random room layouts with 3-5 exits each and one correct exit (follow Silk Flies with Needolin); Wraiths per room rise from 2 to 5; a Wraith grab deals 1+1 and drains 3 silk. Moorwing: 600 HP, contact 2, swipes 1+1, easier since Patch 1. Grand Mother Silk: phase HP 100/192/240/110/242/340 (6 phases).

findings.claim: Reported causes of Steel Soul deaths are mostly environmental hazards, 1+1 grabs and arena gauntlets rather than big bosses.
findings.detail: Reported deaths and hazards: steam hit twice during the first Act 3 sequence; Moorwing (several runs); second Savage Beastfly; the arena before the Whispering Vaults; Lost Lace and Shrine Guardian Seth (both Act 3); Underworks lava platforming; Wisp Thicket without Magma Bell (wisp contact is fire 2); the Mist; Forebrothers lava. Mechanical traps: hazards ignore i-frames (knockback into spikes), grabs that bypass the Fractured Mask, Mount Fay frost ticking 1 mask per 1.75 s, Muckmaggot water in Sinner's Road, Bilewater and Putrified Ducts disabling Bind healing, Clawmaidens and Wraiths removing the silk needed to heal, the Barbed Bracelet doubling damage, and TheGamer's advice that 2 masks or fewer means one hit from death. Community advice is to save-quit whenever near death and to clear enemies before platforming.

findings.claim: Balance changes since launch affect damage tables. The current PC build is 1.0.30000 (Patch 5, 2026-03-24); Team Cherry said no major updates before the Sea of Sorrow expansion, which had no release date on the wiki as of this research.
findings.detail: Patch 1 (1.0.28470 beta / 1.0.28497): Moorwing and Sister Splinter made slightly easier; Sandcarver damage reduced; spinning fans and cogwheels do less damage; some 2-damage enemies reduced (Elder Pilgrim, Choir Elder, Splinterbark); cog double damage removed. Patch 3 (1.0.28891): Hunter focus 25/40% raised to 30/50%; Sharpdart and Cross Stitch damage up; Thread Storm down at high needle levels. Patch 4 (1.0.29242): Fractured Mask now works against volt hazards; Wraith-grab control bug fixed. Patch 5 (1.0.29909-1.0.30000): Last Judge death explosion 3 to 2 and reduced by Magma Bell; Magma Bell covers all fire explosions; Savage Beastfly minions die with the boss; Lace (Cradle) out-of-bounds fixes; bench added by Pale Lake. The decompiled source cited above is launch build 1.0.28324; the EylonShachmon change list covers code changes up to 1.0.30000.

findings.claim: Known boss cheeses and easier approaches exist for Fourth Chorus, Lace 2, Trobbio, Sister Splinter, Cogwork Dancers, Grand Mother Silk, Savage Beastfly and the Forum gauntlet.
findings.detail: Fourth Chorus: in phase 3, fly with Drifter's Cloak to the arena edge and hit the explosive rocks to drop a boulder, or skip the fight entirely. Forum gauntlet: Architect Crest + Cogflies, and plasmify twice for mask regeneration. Lace 2: Cross Stitch. Trobbio: Magma Bell (disputed by the wiki). Sister Splinter: Beast Crest breaks vines in 2 hits. Cogwork Dancers: Ascendant's Grip wall-cling in a corner, Threefold Pin + Pollip Pouch poison. Grand Mother Silk: Tacks on the floor during phase 1. Savage Beastfly: lure it so its slam kills its own summons. Last Judge / Father of the Flame: Magma Bell.

findings.claim: Several web sources return made-up or unrelated Silksong mechanics numbers and should be excluded from the bot's knowledge base.
findings.detail: silksong.codes 'Speedrun Guide' lists bosses that do not exist ('Greymoor Guardian', 'Gilded Hunter', 'Citadel Warden'). expertgamereviews.com 'frame data' pages give unsourced i-frame counts ('8-12 i-frames'). The 0.45 s / 0.35 s invulnerability and hitstun snippet is from the itch.io game 'Into The Core'. A WebFetch summary of the wiki Mask Shard page wrongly said Hornet starts with 3 masks; the raw wiki text says 5.

implications_for_bot: Aim both achievements at one run: Steel Soul mode with the Weaver Queen (Act 2) ending under 5 h of in-game playTime. Act 3 is unnecessary, which removes Lost Lace, Seth, frost-heavy content and Act 3 steam from the risk set.
Default to worst-case damage: assume 2 masks for any boss contact or attack and any armed or large enemy. The HP-safety threshold should be counted in hits remaining (floor(masks/2)), not masks.

Implement an emergency save-quit policy: pause, then Quit to Menu, then reload to the last bench. Trigger it before the dangerous hit (e.g. masks ≤ 2, or ≤ 4 in the Mist), because pause is disabled during every hit-freeze. Never rely on killing the process after death; death is saved immediately.

The terrain map must flag hazard tiles (spikes, lava, acid, coal, zap, steam, pits, frost zones), and the combat controller must treat them as lethal even during i-frames. Model knockback (away from the damage side, about 0.5x vertical) and refuse to fight on ledges above hazards unless Weighted Belt halves knockback.

The Bind controller must commit only when no threat is predicted to land within the Bind time: 1.37 s base, 0.89 s with Injector Band, about 1.0 s Beast, 1.05 s Witch. A missed heal also wipes all silk, so track silk ≥ 9 and prefer Warding Bell + Injector Band. Heal during boss stagger windows or after long telegraphed attacks.

The i-frame model should use about 1.0 s after a hit (1.3 s with Weighted Belt), 0.25 s after a needle clash/parry, 2-10 physics steps on pogo, and Cross Stitch/Sharpdart windows. Dash and sprint have NO i-frames: dodge by moving out of the hitbox, not through it. Treat all these constants as measure-and-verify on build 1.0.30000.

Crest choice for a bot: Wanderer (straight-down pogo, fast silk gain, easy parries) or Reaper (wide down-slash, silk after Bind). Avoid Beast, Witch and Shaman as the main healing crest, because their heals need enemies or ground contact. The pogo planner must use the crest's down-slash geometry.

Minimum defensive loadout for a scripted run: Fractured Mask (buy from Mottled Skarr, 260 rosaries, before dangerous areas), Warding Bell (free, Far Fields), Magma Bell for Last Judge, Wisp Thicket and lava, and Weighted Belt (160 rosaries). Consider Magnetite Dice in a spare yellow slot. Never Barbed Bracelet.

Route selection: choose between the Last Judge route (known pattern, all 2-damage, Magma Bell) and the Mist + Phantom route. The Mist has random room layouts, Wraith grabs that drain silk and bypass the Fractured Mask, and it grants Cross Stitch. For a vision bot the Last Judge route is probably more deterministic. Skip Moorwing via 5 fleas if the flea route fits, and consider the Fourth Chorus and Sister Splinter skips only if they are more reliable than the fights.

Budget extra safety and practice for the Forum gauntlet (Conductor's Melody): kill Clawmaidens early (silk theft), recruit Garmond & Zaza (beat them in the Whispering Vaults) or Shakra (Trail's End) as helpers, and treat the final two Choir Clappers as a boss.

State tracking should read masks, blue/plasmium masks, silk (including the 9-silk Bind-ready glow), Fractured Mask intact/broken, Magma Bell cooldown icon, Muckmaggot infestation, frost meter, Hunter focus and Beast fury. The HUD shows most of these; alternatively PlayerData fields (health, healthBlue, silk, silkMax, disablePause, permadeathMode, playTime) and HeroController cState (invulnerable, recoiling, parryInvulnTimer, downspikeInvulnerabilitySteps).
Version-lock the bot to one game build (currently 1.0.30000). Damage tables and Fractured Mask edge cases changed across Patches 1-5, and the Sea of Sorrow expansion may change content again.
open_questions: What are the exact serialized values of INVUL_TIME, DAMAGE_FREEZE_DOWN/WAIT/UP, RECOIL_VELOCITY, INVUL_TIME_PARRY/CROSS_STITCH/SILKDASH on 1.0.30000? They are prefab-serialized and absent from the decompile, so they need an in-game memory read or a mod dump.
Do the Fractured Mask grab exceptions (Muckroach Maul, Wraith grab, Slubberlug grab, claw traps) still apply after the Patch 4/5 changes to DoSpecialDamage and allowFracturedMaskBreak?
Is save-and-quit disabled inside any specific boss arenas, gauntlets or cutscenes (the playerData.disablePause sources beyond hit-freeze)? This decides where the emergency-quit policy is usable.
How exactly does in-game playTime behave across save-quit and reload and on the pause menu? This matters for the 18000 s Speedrunner limit.
Is the hazard-during-i-frames behaviour identical on 1.0.30000? It was confirmed only in launch code 1.0.28324 plus the wiki's Sharpdart note.
Has Sea of Sorrow released by 2026-09-28, and does it change Steel Soul, the achievements or the Act 1-2 route? The wiki page still said the release date was TBD.
For a bot with imperfect execution, which is more reliable: the Last Judge route or the Mist + Phantom route? Are the Fourth Chorus and Sister Splinter skips worth it versus fighting?

Will the user allow BepInEx mods for state reading? Reading memory or using a data-export mod (e.g. afiaka87 hkss-data-export-bus, which patches HeroController.TakeDamage) could replace vision for HP/silk/i-frame state; whether mods affect achievement eligibility or fairness still needs to be checked.

verification.claim: Target achievements are STEEL_SOUL ('Finish the game in Steel Soul mode') and SPEEDRUN_1 ('Complete the game in under 5 hours'); 100% variants SPEED_COMPLETION (<30 h) and STEEL_SOUL_FULL; COMPLETION = 100%. Global rates SPEEDRUN_1 4.9%, SPEED_COMPLETION 4.0%, STEEL_SOUL 3.8%, STEEL_SOUL_FULL 3.0%, COMPLETION 16.9%, ENDING_A 41.0%, ENDING_C 39.5%, ENDING_E 29.7%, ENDING_D 17.3%; 52 achievements.
verification.evidence: Steam API GetGlobalAchievementPercentagesForApp (fetched 2026-09-28) returns exactly 52 keys with those percentages. Steam stats page (l=english) gives the matching names and descriptions: Speedrunner 'Complete the game in under 5 hours', Speed Completion 'Achieve 100% game completion and finish the game in under 30 hours', Steel Soul 'Finish the game in Steel Soul mode', Steel Heart. Decompiled GameManager uses the keys STEEL_SOUL, SPEEDRUN_1, SPEED_COMPLETION, STEEL_SOUL_FULL and COMPLETION. The official Simplified Chinese names (Steam l=schinese) are: 疾丝跑者 = Speedrunner ('5小时内通关游戏'), 极速圆满 = Speed Completion, 钢铁之魂 = Steel Soul, 钢铁之心 = Steel Heart, 圆满无缺 = Completion. So the Speedrunner name is fixed as 疾丝跑者, not 'various'. HERALD_WISH (17.2%) is the 'Passing of the Age' achievement.

verification.claim: GameManager.CheckCompletionAchievements() awards all four completion-type achievements using exact thresholds on playerData.playTime (SPEEDRUN_1 if playTime <= 18000f; SPEED_COMPLETION if 100% and <= 108000f; STEEL_SOUL if permadeathMode > Off). Speedrunner is mode-independent, so one Steel Soul run can earn both. Human runs did this (sina.cn 3h59m ending 1; Bilibili BV1TFpAz8EV7), both using SL.
verification.evidence: Read the decompiled GameManager.cs from the 1.0.28324 decompile (it has playerData.version = "1.0.28324"). The code is verbatim: CountGameCompletion(); flag = permadeathMode > PermadeathModes.Off; flag2 = completionPercentage >= 100f; STEEL_SOUL plus MenuStyleUnlock COMPLETED_STEEL; COMPLETION; STEEL_SOUL_FULL; playTime <= 18000f gives SPEEDRUN_1; flag2 && playTime <= 108000f gives SPEED_COMPLETION. No C# caller exists, so it is invoked from a PlayMaker FSM. Caveat: the check reads playerData.playTime, which only gets sessionPlayTimer added in GetSaveGameData/PreparePlayerDataForSave. The live timer GameManager.PlayTime = sessionStartTime + sessionPlayTimer can therefore be ahead of the value checked, and a bot should budget against GameManager.PlayTime. EylonShachmon's Silksong-change-list (ILSpy diffs 1.0.28324 to 1.0.30000) reports no change to this method or to IncreaseGameTimer. sina.cn: steel soul and speedrun in one run, 3h59m, 一结局, with SL and backups. The Bilibili title '丝之歌钢魂模式完成+五小时速通' says '至少10几次sl、系统回档' and 'not a true Steel Soul clear'.

verification.claim: Any credits-rolling ending counts as finishing; fastest target is Ending 1 Weaver Queen (ENDING_A): beat Grand Mother Silk at end of Act 2 without having done Silk and Soul; Act 3 not required.
verification.corrected_claim: Weaver Queen (ENDING_A, Act 2) is a valid and practical target, and Act 3 is not needed. Its exact requirements (hollowknight.wiki Endings) are: (1) Snared Silk has not been achieved on the save; (2) defeat Grand Mother Silk and BIND her, not play Needolin; (3) Hornet must NOT be locked into the Cursed Crest. Completing Rite of Rebirth without Infestation Operation turns the same fight into Twisted Child (ENDING_D). Having completed Silk and Soul does not prevent Weaver Queen; only using Needolin with the Soul Snare gives Snared Silk (ENDING_C, which continues into Act 3). Ending 1 is empirically confirmed to trigger Steel Soul plus Speedrunner: the sina.cn clear '打了一结局' got both.
verification.evidence: Endings wiki (raw): Weaver Queen requires 'Not having achieved the Snared Silk ending' plus 'Defeating Grand Mother Silk and Binding her'. Snared Silk requires Silk and Soul plus Needolin. Twisted Child requires Rite of Rebirth, NOT Infestation Operation, and defeating GMS. The wiki also says that after Ending 1 or 3 the save respawns at the last save point with the in-game time recorded at the end of the ending cutscene. SetEndingCompleted.cs ORs SaveSlotCompletionIcons.CompletionState (Act2Regular=1, Act2Cursed=2, Act2SoulSnare=4, Act3Ending=8) into CompletedEndings and LastCompletedEnding, and calls RecordGameComplete() (empty). Save Data wiki: RecPermadeathMode is unlocked by reaching the credits (ending A, C, D or E) or by the Extras code up,down,up,down,left,right,left,right. speedrun.com Any% rules: 'Beat the game with any ending & any amount of completion.'

verification.claim: Speedrunner timer is save-file in-game playTime; advances only while GameState is PLAYING/ENTERING_LEVEL/EXITING_LEVEL, inventory closed, and unscaledDeltaTime < 1 s; room transitions count; LOADING only on continue-from-menu; CUTSCENE only for in-game videos/non-gameplay scenes; pause excluded; unscaled time.
verification.evidence: GameManager.IncreaseGameTimer: if ((GameState == PLAYING || ENTERING_LEVEL || EXITING_LEVEL) && !PlayerData.instance.isInventoryOpen && Time.unscaledDeltaTime < 1f) timer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime. It is called each Update on sessionPlayTimer. GameState enum: INACTIVE 0, MAIN_MENU 1, LOADING 2, ENTERING_LEVEL 3, PLAYING 4, PAUSED 5, EXITING_LEVEL 6, CUTSCENE 7, PRIMER 8.
